Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md) ##### Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking * [LawPulse](https://lttxzmj.github.io/lawpulse-site/) - Local-first legal research tool for Chinese lawyers: offline statute library with per-article notes; all data stays on your Mac. ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Design and Product / Other Tools * [Siliconed](https://gwenn-ha-dev.github.io/Siliconed/) - Open-source app for local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, written in Swift and Metal. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/gwenn-ha-dev/Siliconed) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process * [Local Transcriber](https://transcriber.teconomix.net) - Menu bar app that records calls and meetings and transcribes them on-device with Whisper, with speaker recognition, call detection and dictation into any app. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall * [Photo Review](https://danielyaa5.github.io/photo-review/) - Open-source tool that lists an iCloud Photos library by size, then compresses large videos or deletes what you pick. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/danielyaa5/photo-review) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Utilities / Finder Tools * [Strata Files](https://stratafiles.app) - Open-source file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/cristipufu/strata-files) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Utilities / System Related Tools * [Aman Check (⭐33)](https://github.com/MidZai/aman_check) - Dated, honest condition report for a used Mac: locks, battery, SSD and guided hardware tests. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/MidZai/aman_check) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App") #### [3. Awesome Datascience](/content/academic/awesome-datascience/README.md) ##### Projects * [Amazon Bestsellers Tracker (⭐0)](https://github.com/huynhtanan/amazon-bestsellers-tracker) - Open-source Python + SQLite tracker that snapshots Amazon Best Sellers across 17 country stores daily, with example SQL diff queries for rank jumps and new entries. * [Walmart Deals Tracker (⭐0)](https://github.com/huynhtanan/walmart-deals-tracker) - Open-source Python + SQLite watcher for Walmart Rollback-only deals, with example SQL queries for price drops and first-party vs marketplace filtering. ##### Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated) * [US Traffic Ticket Courts and Payment Portals (⭐0)](https://github.com/odebo/us-traffic-ticket-data) - Which court or agency handles a traffic citation in 54 US cities across 21 states, each with the court's own official payment or contest page (no third-party payment sites), fine notes, traffic-school eligibility and points rules. JSON, CSV and JSONL; CC0; no login. * [AI Crawler robots.txt Study](https://huggingface.co/datasets/desearch/ai-crawlers-robots-txt-study) - robots.txt policies of the Tranco top 10,000 domains (October 2026), one row per domain with rank band and whether AI training, AI search and user-triggered crawlers are named or blocked. CSV, CC BY 4.0. #### [5. Static Analysis](/content/analysis-tools-dev/static-analysis/README.md) ##### Programming Languages / [Other](#other-1) * **phploc** :warning: — A tool for quickly measuring the size and analyzing the structure of a PHP project. ##### Other / [Other](#other-1) * [GitStats (⭐94)](https://github.com/shenxianpeng/gitstats) — Generates a static HTML report from a Git repository's history: activity, authors, code ownership, hotspots and bus factor, file churn, tags and lines of code over time. It also counts the commits that name an AI coding assistant (agent accounts, Co-authored-by and Assisted-by lines). Works on any Git repository with only git and Python, writes JSON, compares several repositories, and runs as a GitHub Action. #### [6. Awesome Mongodb](/content/ramnes/awesome-mongodb/README.md) ##### Tools / Administration * [MongoRescue (⭐7)](https://github.com/YigitCittan/mongorescue) - Backup and disaster recovery tool streaming archives to local or S3 storage, with embedded dashboard, continuous PITR, and age encryption #### [7. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md) ##### APIs, Data, and ML * [App AI Gateway](https://appaigateway.com/) - Gateway/proxy for calling AI providers from iOS applications without shipping provider keys or building your own backend. Only allows requests from your real app via App Attest, with rate limits and budgets per user and per app. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per month, no card required. #### [8. Awesome Mqtt](/content/awesome-mqtt/awesome-mqtt/README.md) ##### GoLang * [mqttv5 (⭐5)](https://github.com/ashtonian/mqttv5) - MQTT v5 client with allocation-free PUBLISH decoding, session resume, file-backed QoS 1/2 persistence and multi-broker failover. #### [9. Awesome Python](/content/vinta/awesome-python/README.md) ##### Projects / AI and Agents * Local LLM Inference * [ollama (⭐11k)](https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python) - Python client for Ollama, which downloads and runs open-weight LLMs locally. * [llama-cpp-python (⭐11k)](https://github.com/abetlen/llama-cpp-python) - Python bindings for llama.cpp, for running GGUF models locally. * [mlx-lm (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm) - Run and fine-tune large language models on Apple Silicon with MLX. ##### Projects / Machine Learning * Hyperparameter Optimization * [optuna (⭐15k)](https://github.com/optuna/optuna) - A hyperparameter optimization framework with define-by-run search spaces and pruning of unpromising trials. * [hyperopt (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/hyperopt/hyperopt) - Distributed asynchronous hyperparameter optimization with Tree-structured Parzen Estimators. ##### Projects / Caching * Django * [django-redis (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/jazzband/django-redis) - Full-featured Redis cache backend for Django. * [django-cacheops (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/Suor/django-cacheops) - A slick ORM cache with automatic granular event-driven invalidation. ##### Projects / Search * Vector Search * [faiss-cpu (⭐41k)](https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss) - A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. ##### Projects / Serialization * Object Pickling * [cloudpickle (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/cloudpipe/cloudpickle) - Extends pickle to functions, lambdas, and interactively defined classes, for shipping code to remote workers. * [dill (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/uqfoundation/dill) - Extends pickle to serialize almost any Python object, including closures and whole interpreter sessions. ##### Projects / Environment Management * [mise (⭐35k)](https://github.com/jdx/mise) - A polyglot tool version manager that installs Python versions and reads .python-version files. ##### Projects / Supply Chain Security * Secret Scanning * [betterleaks (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks) - Finds leaked secrets in git history, directories, and files, from the original author of gitleaks. #### [10. Awesome Appium](/content/SrinivasanTarget/awesome-appium/README.md) ##### Cloud * [TestMu AI](https://www.testmuai.com/lambdatest-appium/) - AI-native cloud testing platform (formerly LambdaTest), run Appium tests in parallel on real Android and iOS devices. ##### Test Frameworks * [zosma-qa (⭐9)](https://github.com/zosmaai/zosma-qa) - Unified QA platform with one CLI for Appium mobile testing, Playwright web E2E, and k6 load tests — includes zero-config scaffolding, WebdriverIO test helpers, and AI agents that autonomously plan, generate, and self-heal your test suites. ##### Sample Apps for Practice * [FrontRow (⭐7)](https://github.com/majdukovic/frontrow) - Open source React Native concert ticketing app built specifically as a QA automation training surface. Ships Appium WebdriverIO and TypeScript scaffolds with full WDIO configs for iOS and Android, smoke and login specs, and a central testID registry that maps to accessibility identifiers on both platforms. Includes a QA Debug Menu with force error modes, time travel, and deterministic IAP outcomes for practising failure mode testing. #### [11. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md) ##### Collections / Voxel Editors * :free: [Soundza](https://soundza.com/) - Thousands of free game sound effects, music loops and ambience in WAV/MP3, made by people rather than AI; free for commercial use, no attribution needed. Free API and MCP server. #### [12. ([Source Code](https://github.com/grimmory-tools/grimmory)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker` ##### Software / Travel Organization * [TREK (⭐15k)](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK) - Collaborative trip planner with interactive maps, day-by-day itineraries, budgets, packing lists, reservations, journey journaling, and PWA support. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md) ##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools * [SpaceApp](https://github.com/oll4com/spaceapp) - Self-hosted web workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code and other coding CLIs as side-by-side panes in persistent rooms, with MCP servers and managed browser panes. Install: `npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install`. Source-available (BSL 1.1). ##### Commands & Extensions * [MoltNode by Chord (⭐0)](https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp) - Gemini CLI extension that connects two hosted MCP servers and a `GEMINI.md` context file: MoltNode for JSON-RPC reads on 31 blockchains, and Chord for DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles and wallet PnL. No API key; the agent's own wallet signs every transaction. MIT. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp`. ##### Development Tools & Utilities * [Check (⭐0)](https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini) - Extension with a `BeforeTool` hook that checks each file write on your own machine before Gemini CLI makes it (and, on Linux, each shell command): files, folders, programs, git refs and packages it names must exist, and scripts must parse; what the machine proves wrong is blocked with the machine's message. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini`. Paid, 14-day free trial. * [agy-powerline (⭐15)](https://github.com/wassim-azi/agy-powerline) - Fast, configurable statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), the successor to Gemini CLI, with real-time 5h/7d Gemini quota meters, pace markers, context usage, and interactive TUI editor. Zero dependencies, MIT. ##### MCP Servers * [Pethost](https://pethost.dev?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosting for Docker Compose projects with a remote MCP server (OAuth): Gemini CLI deploys a project, reads its logs and HTTP traffic, and rolls it back. Add it with `gemini mcp add --transport http pethost https://mcp.pethost.dev/mcp`. * [DC Hub (⭐3)](https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server) - Live data for data-center site selection: a daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, plus fiber, gas and electricity prices. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. 94 tools, remote Streamable HTTP, free tier needs no key. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server`. * [Google Hotels MCP (⭐1)](https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Search Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals from Gemini CLI: per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers), 3-month daily price calendars, amenities, nearby places and review topics. Local stdio server (3 tools) wrapping Apify Google Hotels actors; `uvx --from "git+https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp.git@v0.1.2" google-hotels-mcp`. * [AltoRank](https://altorank.co/docs/mcp/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Open-source SEO content software with a hosted MCP server: check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced drafts into a person's review queue. No approve or publish tool. AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable ([source (⭐3)](https://github.com/AltoRank/altorank)). Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Add with `gemini mcp add --transport http altorank https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp`. #### [15. Awesome Gbdev](/content/gbdev/awesome-gbdev/README.md) ##### Tools / Graphics utilities * [Tessarium](https://joelj.itch.io/tessarium) ‡ - Tile-first pixel art level editor with linked tile editing, shared tilesets, and live unique tile and colours-per-tile budget checks for Game Boy and Game Boy Color backgrounds. #### [16. The answers live in the repo as YAML the agent is held to, next to a decision log.\        * [pstack-claude (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude) by [Michael Denyer](https://github.com/michael-denyer/) - Claude Code version of Lauren Tan's Poteto's pstack. It also counts the commits that name an AI coding assistant (agent accounts, Co-authored-by and Assisted-by lines). #### [1. Awesome Blazor](/content/AdrienTorris/awesome-blazor/README.md)

##### Videos / Others

*   [Blazor Community Standup: Build agentic experiences with the Blazor AI Components](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XT6KEenXgEc) - October 6, 2026 - ![duration](https://img.shields.io/badge/Duration:%20-68%20min-%230094FF?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=maxAge\&logo=youtube) Modern AI applications are more than chat experiences. Learn how to use the new Blazor AI Components to build agent-centric apps where AI agents actively participate in the user experience, driving workflows, taking actions, and helping users get work done.

#### [2. Collective Ai Tools](/content/Hyraze/collective-ai-tools/README.md)

##### App Builder

*   [VibeKit](https://vibekit.bot/) - Mobile-first AI app builder where each app gets its own persistent coding agent that builds it, hosts it on a live domain and keeps improving it, from an iPhone or the web. `#freemium`

#### [3. Awesome Flame](/content/flame-engine/awesome-flame/README.md)

By [Illumination Development](https://illuminationdevelopment.com)

#### [4. Awesome Iot](/content/HQarroum/awesome-iot/README.md)

##### Software / Operating systems

*   [Snappy Ubuntu](https://ubuntu.com/core) - Snappy Ubuntu Core is a new rendition of Ubuntu with transactional updates.  It provides a minimal server image with the same libraries as today’s Ubuntu, but applications are provided through a simpler mechanism.

##### Software / Miscellaneous

*   [ESP32 iPhone Agent (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent) - An ESP32-S3 plugged into an iPhone acts as a Wi-Fi-controlled USB mouse and keyboard, so an AI vision model can operate the phone through AirPlay screen mirroring.

##### Alliances / \- [XMPP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XMPP) (IETF)

*   [AIOTI](https://aioti.eu/) - The Internet of Things Innovation (AIOTI) aims to strengthen links and build new relationships between the different IoT players (industries, SMEs, startups) and sectors.

##### Projects / Automation, Manufacturing, and Robotics

*   [Gearotons M17 (⭐14)](https://github.com/tomrodinger/servomotor) - Integrated servomotor with the motor, driver, motion controller and encoder in one NEMA 17 body.
*   [SO-ARM 102 (⭐138)](https://github.com/roboninecom/SO-ARM-102) - 3D-printable leader-follower robotic arm with a parallel gripper, open CAD files, a bill of materials, and assembly instructions.

##### Projects / Consumer Devices

*   [Tiny Film Camera (⭐18)](https://github.com/SuveenE/tiny-film-camera) - Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W digital camera with physical controls, three selectable image filters, and a 3D-printable enclosure.

##### Platforms / Integrated Circuit

*   [ICBOMS](https://icboms.com) - Open electronic component search engine, BOM management platform, and semiconductor distribution database.
*   [RoboPartPicker](https://robopartpicker.com) - Compiles bills of materials from open robotics projects and tracks parts sourcing, keeping unresolved and unpriced lines visible instead of dropping them.

##### Email Search / Email Check / GitHub

*   [OpenLeads (⭐32)](https://github.com/Samyrrrrrr990/openleads) - Open-source CLI that finds people and their work emails from public sources (OpenStreetMap, GitHub, OpenAlex, SEC EDGAR, company team pages) and labels each address as found, pattern, or guessed. Runs locally, no API keys.

##### Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

*   [JET Pilot](https://jet-pilot.app/) - Open-source Kubernetes desktop client for working across clusters, namespaces and cloud accounts. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/unxsist/jet-pilot) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Terminal Apps / Databases

*   [Termstead](https://khorenyan.com/termstead/) - Native SSH client with a session tree, jump hosts and SFTP beside the terminal. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/pkhorenyan/termstead) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [Utter (⭐2)](https://github.com/h3x-levi/Utter) - On-device voice dictation and meeting transcription powered by whisper.cpp and Metal. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/h3x-levi/Utter) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Utilities / System Related Tools

*   [ftop (⭐241)](https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop) - Floating system monitor for Apple Silicon that adapts its layout to any window size, showing per-core usage and frequency, GPU, memory pressure, and network. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

#### [13. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### Feature Toggles Management Platforms

*   [Flagpool](https://www.flagpool.io/en/) - Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.

##### PaaS

*   [Staxa](https://staxa.dev/) - Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.

##### Projects / AI and Agents

*   LLM Serving
    *   [vllm (⭐93k)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) - A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
    *   [sglang (⭐37k)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) - A high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.

#### [15. Awesome Go](/content/abordage/awesome-go/README.md)

##### Concurrency / Goroutines

*   [hmdsefi/gowl (⭐71)](https://github.com/hmdsefi/gowl) — Gowl is a process management and process monitoring tool at once. An infinite worker pool gives you the ability to control the pool and processes and monitor their status. ☆`71`

#### [16. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md)

##### Engines and Frameworks / Voxel Editors

*   :tada: [Mibo (⭐32)](https://github.com/AngelMunoz/Mibo) - Elmish (MVU) F# game framework on raylib-cs or MonoGame.

##### AI / Voxel Editors

*   :free: [IndieToolChest](https://indietoolchest.com) - Curated directory of AI tools for indie game dev, organized by task (art, 3D, audio, NPCs, code, QA, marketing).

##### Websites / Misc

*   [Fabio Souto](https://fabiosouto.me/) originally created this repo.
*   [Cloudish](https://cloudish.ai) hosts [awesomedataviz.com](https://awesomedataviz.com).

#### [18. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### Interfaces

*   [Yaw](https://yaw.sh?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Cross-platform terminal that auto-detects Gemini CLI and opens a split-pane workflow with a companion terminal.
*   [Termly](https://termly.dev/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free native iOS and Android app to monitor and control Gemini CLI (and other CLI AI assistants) remotely. Zero-knowledge E2E encryption, pairs in under 60 seconds via QR code. No subscriptions, no usage limits.
*   [AnywhereDesign](https://anywheredesign.site?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Local-first voice cockpit and remote mobile interface for Claude Code & Antigravity/Gemini CLI. Control terminal agent sessions from your phone via local QR code, real-time voice dictation, live terminal output streaming, and zero-token mobile Git sync.
*   [Mobile SSH](https://mobile-ssh.github.io/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.
*   [Bellows](https://bellowsai.app?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Tars](https://tars.saccolabs.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.
*   [VibeFuse](https://fuseintelligence.org/products/vibefuse?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).
*   [Drevon](https://www.drevon.dev?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Mac app that connects to your Claude Code or Codex and turns it into an end-to-end GTM operator: research, grunt work, analysis and actions across your stack from a single prompt, in your own browser with your own logins.

##### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [IssueDB](https://issue-queue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llm_agents.html?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
*   [MCP Config Doctor](https://mcpconfigdoctor.online/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI `~/.gemini/settings.json` MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
*   [Usage HUD](https://hud.thaliabloom.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
*   [Agent Cat](https://agentcat.app?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.
*   [Awakado](https://awakado.noodledragon.studio?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
*   [SkillKeeper](https://skillkeeper.app/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
*   [MacMD Viewer](https://macmdviewer.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.
*   [tokenreceipt (⭐1)](https://github.com/henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt) - Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: `npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt`.
*   [Wardlume](https://wardlume.github.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.

##### API Bridges & Proxies

*   [TeamoRouter](https://teamorouter.cn?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).

##### MCP Servers

*   [TWZRD Agent Intel](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: `score_agent`, `preflight_check`. Paid (x402): `get_trust_receipt`. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.
*   [AISO Tools MCP](https://aisotools.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Query a catalog of 1,636 AI tools from the CLI: keyword/category/pricing search, side-by-side comparison, and alternatives lookup, with a canonical citation URL on every result. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http aisotools https://aisotools.com/api/mcp`.
*   [ContextStream](https://contextstream.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Shared project context for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Grok. Intelligence isn’t the bottleneck. Context is. Remote MCP for Gemini CLI and other coding agents: `https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp`.
*   [SkillAgent](https://skillagent.dev?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) for searching \~3,500 agent skills, rules files (including Gemini rules) and MCP servers indexed hourly from GitHub, with project-based recommendations and per-agent install instructions for Gemini CLI. Install: `gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp`.

#### [1. Awesome Zsh Plugins](/content/unixorn/awesome-zsh-plugins/README.md)

##### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [certview (⭐0)](https://github.com/jnnrgd/certview) - Fast inspection and verification of X.509 certificates, CSRs, and cryptographic keys (RSA, ECC, Ed25519) in both PEM and DER formats.
*   [debian (⭐0)](https://github.com/tmiland/oh-my-zsh-debian) - Provides Debian-related aliases and functions. Forked from the oh-my-zsh [debian (⭐190k)](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/tree/master/plugins/debian) plugin.
*   [ls-branch-label (⭐1)](https://github.com/freddi-kit/zsh-ls-branch-label) - Shows the current `git` branch next to repository directories when you run a plain `ls`.
*   [pratchett (⭐0)](https://github.com/loudoncloud/pratchett) - Displays a random Terry Pratchett quote from the Discworld novels, copied verbatim from Wikiquote. Includes a quote of the day, filtering by book, search, and tab completion; DEATH delivers his own lines if `cowsay` is installed.
*   [rfig (⭐19)](https://github.com/tamia6/rfig) - Adds command completion menus and directory-scoped history autosuggestions to ZSH, Bash and Fish on macOS and Linux. Written in Rust.
*   [zdx-suite (⭐1)](https://github.com/landerox/zdx-suite) - Interactive, [fzf (⭐83k)](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf)-powered developer workflows and a custom plugin loader for ZSH, built for [oh-my-zsh](https://ohmyz.sh/).

##### Themes / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [partner (⭐1)](https://github.com/epicseven-cup/partner-theme-zsh) - Theme where every `git` branch hatches its own pet. Your pet evolves as you commit on the branch, so your prompt shows how much work you've put in. Includes decorators for `git` branch and current directory.

##### Concurrency

*   [Kaspar-HFT (⭐33)](https://github.com/vincent212/kaspar-hft) - A C++20 actor framework and trading system with synchronous message delivery (fast\_send), order-book reconstruction and a queue-exact replay simulator. \[MIT]

##### Image Processing

*   [FreeImageRe (⭐31)](https://github.com/agruzdev/FreeImageRe) - A fork of FreeImage to support latest image codecs and adjust for modern compilers. All original formats and plugins are maintained. \[GPLv2, GPLv3, FIPL]

##### Projects / Data Integration

*   [Apache SeaTunnel (⭐9.7k) (⭐9.7k)](https://github.com/apache/seatunnel) - High-performance, distributed data integration platform supporting batch and streaming synchronization across hundreds of connectors.

##### Projects / Message Broker

*   [Apache Iggy (⭐5k) (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/apache/iggy) - Persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, supporting QUIC, TCP, and HTTP transports with high throughput and low latency.

##### Projects / Schema Registry

*   [Apicurio Registry (⭐942) (⭐939)](https://github.com/Apicurio/apicurio-registry) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.

##### Projects / Workflow Engine

*   [Bonita (⭐177) (⭐176)](https://github.com/bonitasoft/bonita-engine) - Open-source BPMN engine with a designer interface to build and automate complex business processes.

20. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • TunnelFlow (⭐3) - Modern SSH tunnel and port forwarding manager supporting local, remote, and dynamic SOCKS5 forwards.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • inlaut - Fully local push-to-talk dictation for German and English, running a Parakeet model on-device and typing at the cursor.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • MemStats - Menu bar memory monitor that splits RAM usage by user account, groups helper processes into apps, and shows memory pressure and swap.

21. Free for Dev

Issue Tracking and Project Management

  • AgileHero - All-in-one project management tool. Free plan includes kanban board, backlog, epics, estimation poker, MCP server, REST API and webhooks for 2 users.

Storage and Media Processing

  • imgduck.com - Minimalist and fast image hosting service with direct link and API support. Free tier offers 1GB storage and unlimited requests per month

22. Awesome Mqtt

Tools

  • Spitfire - Self-hosted distributed load testing platform with a web UI; simulates thousands of MQTT devices (QoS 0/1/2 publish, subscribe, request-reply) alongside HTTP, Kafka and other protocols. Commercial, with a free edition.

23. Awesome Python

Projects / Job Schedulers

  • Workflow Orchestration
    • temporalio (⭐1.2k) - Temporal SDK for durable, fault-tolerant workflows that survive crashes and retries.
    • dagster (⭐16k) - An orchestration platform for the development, production, and observation of data assets.
    • apache-airflow (⭐47k) - Airflow is a platform to programmatically author, schedule and monitor workflows.
    • prefect (⭐24k) - A modern workflow orchestration framework that makes it easy to build, schedule and monitor robust data pipelines.

24. Awesome Gemini Cli

Development Tools & Utilities

  • spillage (⭐3) - Finds API keys in the chats, logs and checkpoints Gemini CLI keeps under ~/.gemini/tmp and in the MCP servers of ~/.gemini/settings.json, redacts them in place, and installs BeforeAgent / BeforeTool / SessionEnd hooks (spillage guard install) that block a prompt with a key in it and reads of .env. Python, no dependencies, no network; also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor.

MCP Servers

  • QRX (⭐2) - Turn a text prompt and a link into an artistic, branded QR code from Gemini CLI. Each code is checked to scan before it is returned and uses a hosted qrx.to short link. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key, or local stdio via npx -y @qrxcodes/mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http qrx https://qrx.codes/mcp.
  • Hoot Lens (⭐2) - Session replays and click heatmaps from real website visits. Find clicks that broke, jump to the JavaScript error and source line, and check whether a fix helped. Remote with OAuth (httpUrl: https://mcp.hootlens.com/mcp) or local with npx -y @hootlens/mcp. Demo with sample data, no sign-in: https://mcp.hootlens.com/demo.
  • Blawgy (⭐2) - Run your SEO blog from Gemini CLI. Research keywords, manage the content plan, write and update SEO blog posts with images and internal links, publish them to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, and read Search Console traffic, rankings and indexing status. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source, included on every paid plan with a free trial. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp.
  • DropTheHassle (⭐2) - Lets Gemini CLI publish the site it built on a real HTTPS link instead of localhost: a free link, no account needed. For your own .com it hands the human a €19/$19-a-year payment link; after payment the site goes live on it with no DNS. No tool spends money. For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via npx -y dropthehassle-mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http dropthehassle https://dropthehassle.com/mcp.

25. Awesome Rust

Applications / Text editors

  • Oleafly/Oleafly (⭐212) - A desktop editor for writing papers and theses in LaTeX, Typst and Markdown, with a built-in Tectonic engine and live PDF preview. Built with Tauri.

items.content_text: #### [1. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md) ##### Commands & Extensions * [assay (⭐102)](https://github.com/awss1i/assay) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with `pip install assay-ui`, then add the skill file. MIT. ##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools * [Mudroom (⭐2)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/mudroom) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied. * [DHI Orbit (⭐1)](https://github.com/Dv04/dhi-orbit) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (`gemini --resume -p`). Python standard library only, MIT. * [Crewly (⭐86)](https://github.com/stevehuang0115/crewly) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in. ##### Development Tools & Utilities * [yoink (⭐5)](https://github.com/MajidRaimi/yoink) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth\_creds.json and google\_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app. * [aisw (⭐124)](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live `~/.gemini` state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: [aiswitcher.dev](https://aiswitcher.dev). * [LynxPrompt (⭐52)](https://github.com/GeiserX/LynxPrompt) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the `lynxp` CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0. ##### MCP Servers * [Selvedge (⭐24)](https://github.com/masondelan/selvedge) - Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. Setup: `selvedge setup --agent gemini`. * [Unsora (⭐2)](https://github.com/Shipped-Studio/unsora) - AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in `apps/mcp`), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp`. * [looot (⭐1)](https://github.com/loootai/looot-mcp) - Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest. * [BulkPublish (⭐3)](https://github.com/azeemkafridi/bulkpublish-api/tree/main/mcp-server) - Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via `npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server` with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp`. * [Tapetide MCP (⭐136)](https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp) - Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via `npx -y tapetide-mcp`; free plan available. MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp`. #### [2. Awesome Gdpr](/content/bakke92/awesome-gdpr/README.md) ##### Training and awareness (art. 39) * [RansomLeak GDPR Training](https://ransomleak.com/catalogue/privacy-compliance/) - Interactive exercises on lawful bases, DSAR handling, breach response, DPIA, records of processing, and cross-border transfers. ##### Tools * [consentprobe (⭐0)](https://github.com/Elijas121/consentprobe) - CLI and GitHub Action that tests whether a website stops tracking after the visitor rejects cookies. * [disclosedby](https://disclosedby.com) - Dated record of the subprocessor lists software companies publish under art. 28, with what changed and when; open JSON, Markdown and an MCP server. ##### Related * [PIPEDA vs GDPR: What Canadian Companies Must Know](https://traztech.ca/blog/pipeda-vs-gdpr) - Comparison of Canadian and EU privacy regulations for companies operating in both jurisdictions. #### [3. Awesome V](/content/vlang/awesome-v/README.md) ##### Games * [VCraft (⭐6)](https://github.com/gabytz777/vcraft) - A voxel sandbox game written entirely in V with procedural terrain, biomes, water, mining/building, and a hotbar HUD. #### [4. Awesome Executable Packing](/content/packing-box/awesome-executable-packing/README.md) ##### :books: Literature / Scientific Research * :mortar\_board: [Building a smart and automated tool for packed malware detection using machine learning](https://dial.uclouvain.be/memoire/ucl/en/object/thesis:25193) (June 2020) * :newspaper: [A packer identification method based on section-entropy plot](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s42400-025-00416-y) (February 2026) :star: * :notebook: [Packing induced bias in deep learning malware classifiers: A systematic experimental study](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11395794) (February 2026) ##### :package: Packers / After 2010 * [HimitsuShell (⭐68)](https://github.com/HimitsuShell/HimitsuShell) - A shell script protector that converts shell scripts into binaries with an embedded interpreter, obfuscation, and anti-debug protections (shc alternative). ##### :wrench: Tools / Before 2000 * [XVolkolak (⭐4)](https://github.com/horsicq/XVolkolak) - Qt/CMake emulator-unpacker project with a GUI and a console application. #### [5. Awesome Javascript](/content/sorrycc/awesome-javascript/README.md) ##### MVC Frameworks and Libraries / Runner * [pion (⭐131)](https://github.com/pionjs/pion) - React Hooks API for standard web components with lit-html. #### [6. Awesome Go](/content/avelino/awesome-go/README.md) ##### Advanced Console UIs * [eyez (⭐1)](https://github.com/tech-thinker/eyez) - eyez is a handy CLI tool that lets you view images directly in your terminal, with support for most terminal emulators. ##### Networking * [telepath (⭐3)](https://github.com/tech-thinker/telepath) - telepath is a powerful CLI tool for secure port forwarding with support for multiple jump hosts and flexible authentication. ##### Security * [certifier (⭐1)](https://github.com/0x524a/certifier) - Library and CLI for generating and validating X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, CRLs, and OCSP responses. ##### Video * [onvif-go (⭐40)](https://github.com/0x524a/onvif-go) - ONVIF client, WS-Discovery and virtual camera server for IP cameras. * [rtspeek (⭐1)](https://github.com/0x524a/rtspeek) - Library and CLI for probing RTSP streams and reporting reachability, latency, codecs, and resolutions. ##### Code Analysis / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares * [gocondense (⭐19)](https://github.com/abemedia/gocondense) - A gofmt-compatible formatter that condenses multi-line constructs onto single lines where they fit. #### [7. Awesome Machine Learning](/content/josephmisiti/awesome-machine-learning/README.md) ##### Python / Speech Recognition * [tiny-audio (⭐169)](https://github.com/alexkroman/tiny-audio) - Minimal, hackable PyTorch/Hugging Face codebase for training LLM-based speech recognition by connecting a frozen pretrained speech encoder to a pretrained LLM through a small trained projector, with word timestamps, speaker diarization and a free course. #### [8. Collective Ai Tools](/content/Hyraze/collective-ai-tools/README.md) ##### Chatbots * [Honer AI](https://xoner4.github.io/) - Android assistant for AI conversations, writing, translation, and web search with sources, with Russian and English interfaces. `#free` ##### Developer Tools * [ERIUS PHONE](https://eriusphone.com/) - Hosted Android phones that an AI agent controls over an HTTP API or an open-source MCP server to use and test apps: read the screen, tap, type, swipe, install APKs, and pull crash logs. Early access.`#paid` `#testing` `#opensource` * [VideoGen API](https://videogen.io/videogen-api) - REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs for creating editable marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers, then editing and exporting projects; a VideoGen account and paid generation credits are required. `#paid` `#api` ##### Finance * [Equibles](https://equibles.com/) - US stock market data for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants through a hosted MCP server and a REST API, covering SEC filings, financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades and 13F holdings. `#freemium` `#mcp` * [Tapetide](https://tapetide.com/mcp) - Indian stock market MCP server: research, screen and track about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client. `#freemium` `#mcp` `#opensource` ##### Image Generator * [MyPhotoAI](https://myphotoai.io/) - Turn your selfies into AI headshots and portraits. `#paid` ##### Productivity * [Tale](https://tale.dev/) - Open-source project workspace where teams assign tasks to AI agents in persistent sandboxes and review their reports and deliverables together. `#free` `#opensource` ##### Search Engine * [AI Compare](https://www.aicompare.ninja/en/) - Free editorial AI-tool search and comparison with sourced pricing, limits, and an LLM API cost calculator. `#free` `#research` ##### Social Media * [Unsora](https://tryunsora.com/) - Generates AI images, video, music and voiceovers and schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and other connected accounts. `#paid` `#opensource` ##### Video * [DoneCut](https://donecut.com/) - Upload raw footage and an AI editor returns a finished YouTube video or Shorts with captions, motion graphics and music. `#paid` * [SeedanceCheap](https://seedancecheap.com/) - Independent Seedance 2.5 studio for 30-second video requests with free prompt planners, one-time paid packs, an eligibility-limited first trial, and an account-scoped generation API. `#paid` * [ScaleReach](https://www.scalereach.ai/) - Turns long YouTube and other videos into 9:16 short clips with AI captions and face-tracking crop. `#paid` * [VideoGen](https://videogen.io/) - Creates editable product and marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers in a browser editor with captions and exports; paid generation credits are required. `#paid` `#video` ##### Writing * [Dearovo](https://www.dearovo.com/) - AI relationship message writer with context, tone, and length controls. `#freemium` #### [9. Awesome Osint](/content/jivoi/awesome-osint/README.md) ##### Google Dorks Tools * [DorkEye (⭐149)](https://github.com/xPloits3c/DorkEye) - Automated Google dorking tool that generates thousands of advanced queries per second from a file to find exposed files, thanks to CAPTCHA bypass and ban avoidance. It also tests for vulnerabilities, runs multi-agent analysis, and extracts metadata. ##### Image Analysis / GitHub * [TrueScreen C2PA Viewer](https://truescreen.io/c2pa-viewer/) - Free in-browser tool that reads and checks the Content Credentials (C2PA manifest) of a file, with no upload and no account. ##### Data and Statistics / GitHub * [NarcoScope](https://narcoscope.com) - Public-interest explorer of official drug-market prices, precursor flows, seizures, and public-health context, with source links and explicit evidence gaps. ##### Web Monitoring / GitHub * [Wayback-Diff (⭐2)](https://github.com/GeiserX/Wayback-Diff) #### [10. Free Programming Books (Japanese)](/content/EbookFoundation/free-programming-books/books/free-programming-books-ja/README.md) ##### JavaScript / Vue.js * [The chibivue Book](https://book.chibivue.land/ja/) - ubugeeei #### [11. Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md) ##### Developer Tools / Developer Utilities * [Device Hub Pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - Mirror, control and test Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App") ##### Design and Product / Screen Recording * [Caplo (⭐20)](https://github.com/icloudza/caplo) - Screen recorder and editor with automatic camera moves, cursor effects, canvas, and captions. ##### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools * [FreeAudio (⭐2)](https://github.com/hakanotal/FreeAudio) - Per-app volume and mute, output device switching, and volume control for HDMI/DisplayPort monitors. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/hakanotal/FreeAudio) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") * [FreeDisplay (⭐4)](https://github.com/hakanotal/FreeDisplay) - Control external display brightness, HiDPI modes, resolution, and arrangement from the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/hakanotal/FreeDisplay) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall * [Boost (⭐16)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/boost) - Free memory without closing apps, freeze apps and restore them exactly as they were, and find disk space that's genuinely safe to reclaim. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/boost) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Utilities / Productivity * [QDuo](https://xueshi.dev/qduo/) - Popup at the cursor that runs your own actions on selected text in any app: AI prompts, search, text transforms, Shortcuts, and shell scripts. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/XueshiQiao/qduo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App") ##### Utilities / Finder Tools * [FinderRight (⭐14)](https://github.com/funny-dog/FinderRight) - Open-source Finder extension that adds new file, open in terminal, copy path, and cut & paste to the right-click menu. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/funny-dog/FinderRight) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") #### [12. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md) ##### APIs, Data, and ML * [IP99](https://ip99.com/) - IP risk and geolocation API with passive DNS and certificate transparency. Free without a key: 500 IP lookups/day; 10 domain/cert trial lookups/day. #### [13. Awesome Selfhosted](/content/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted/README.md) ##### Software / Analytics * [Dreeve](https://dreeve.app/) `⚠` - Statistics dashboard generated from Strava data. ([Demo](https://statistics-for-strava.robiningelbrecht.be/), [Source Code (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/dreeveapp/dreeve)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker/K8S` ##### Software / Inventory Management * [CellarBoss](https://cellarboss.org) - Wine inventory management system. ([Source Code (⭐2)](https://github.com/CellarBoss/cellarboss)) `GPL-3.0` `Docker/Nodejs` ##### Software / Self-hosting Solutions * [Mother-of-All-Self-Hosting (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/mother-of-all-self-hosting/mash-playbook) - Ansible playbook which helps you host services as Docker containers on your own server. `AGPL-3.0` `Ansible/Docker` #### [14. Awesome Rust](/content/rust-unofficial/awesome-rust/README.md) ##### Applications * [pelazas/p2pmux (⭐72)](https://github.com/pelazas/p2pmux) \[[p2pmux](https://crates.io/crates/p2pmux)] - Peer-to-peer terminal multiplexer for macOS and Linux where multiple users and machines join the same session; every pane is a real shell on the machine of whoever opened it [![CI](https://github.com/pelazas/p2pmux/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/pelazas/p2pmux/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ##### Applications / Web Servers * [ferronweb/ferron (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/ferronweb/ferron) - A fast, modern web server built for production debugging. [![Rust (Ferron 3.x)](https://github.com/ferronweb/ferron/actions/workflows/rust.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ferronweb/ferron/actions/workflows/rust.yml) ##### Development tools / Build system * [euv-cli (⭐16)](https://github.com/euv-dev/euv) \[[euv-cli](https://crates.io/crates/euv-cli)] - The official CLI tool for the euv UI framework, providing dev/release profiles with run/build modes, hot reload, and wasm-pack integration. ##### Development tools / Static analysis * [MykytaStel/repopilot (⭐24)](https://github.com/MykytaStel/repopilot) \[[repopilot](https://crates.io/crates/repopilot)] - Local, deterministic review of Git changes, including AI-agent edits: weakened tests and checks, callers broken by removed APIs, and risky boundary changes; CLI, MCP server and agent hooks [![CI](https://github.com/MykytaStel/repopilot/actions/workflows/ci.yaml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/MykytaStel/repopilot/actions/workflows/ci.yaml) ##### Libraries / Artificial Intelligence * [Mattbusel/tokio-prompt-orchestrator (⭐59)](https://github.com/Mattbusel/tokio-prompt-orchestrator) \[[tokio-prompt-orchestrator](https://crates.io/crates/tokio-prompt-orchestrator)] - Tokio pipeline for serving LLM requests with dedup, circuit breakers, retries, rate limits and a dead-letter queue in front of Anthropic, OpenAI, llama.cpp or vLLM. #### [15. Awesome Claude Code](/content/hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code/README.md) ##### Research & Scientific Inquiry / Data Visualization * [geo-sleuth (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/Oldcircle/geo-sleuth) by [Oldcircle](https://github.com/Oldcircle) - An agent skill that geolocates a photo with no readable text. Single-purpose Python scripts search and rank candidates using OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view. The answer comes with a camera position, heading, error radius and an evidence image. NOTE: Scripts involve contact with Baidu and Yandex.\        ##### Providers, Runtime & Integration Infrastructure / Data Visualization * [Agents Can Communicate (ACC) (⭐129)](https://github.com/automatis-tools/agents-can-communicate) by [Mykola Maksymenko](https://github.com/maksymenkoml) - Local, multi-provider agent communication tool. Adds hooks and a skill to exchange questions and reviews, and saves decisions, verification results and handoffs for later sessions. Each session keeps its own client, model, conversation and permissions.\        * [Claude Code Local (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/nicedreamzapp/claude-code-local) by [Matt Macosko](https://github.com/nicedreamzapp) - Runs Claude Code fully on-device on Apple Silicon: a native MLX server speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so the unmodified claude CLI works against local Qwen, Gemma and Llama models with no cloud calls. Includes RAM-based model selection, a tool-call parser for local models' output formats, and a verified-offline mode.\        * [Repowire (⭐265)](https://github.com/prassanna-ravishankar/repowire) by [Prassanna Ravishankar](https://github.com/prassanna-ravishankar) - A live mesh network that connects Claude Code and other providers so they can talk to each other in real time. Built for emergent coordination. Agents discover each other and share context across project boundaries. Uses tmux sessions as the coordination layer with logical "circles" for peer isolation. 1. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • assay (⭐102) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with pip install assay-ui, then add the skill file. MIT.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Mudroom (⭐2) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied.
  • DHI Orbit (⭐1) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (gemini --resume <id> -p). Python standard library only, MIT.
  • Crewly (⭐86) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • yoink (⭐5) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.
  • aisw (⭐124) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.
  • LynxPrompt (⭐52) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.

MCP Servers

  • Selvedge (⭐24) - Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. Setup: selvedge setup --agent gemini.
  • Unsora (⭐2) - AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in apps/mcp), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp.
  • looot (⭐1) - Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest.
  • BulkPublish (⭐3) - Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp.
  • Tapetide MCP (⭐136) - Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via npx -y tapetide-mcp; free plan available. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp.

2. Awesome Gdpr

Training and awareness (art. 39)

  • RansomLeak GDPR Training - Interactive exercises on lawful bases, DSAR handling, breach response, DPIA, records of processing, and cross-border transfers.

Tools

  • consentprobe (⭐0) - CLI and GitHub Action that tests whether a website stops tracking after the visitor rejects cookies.
  • disclosedby - Dated record of the subprocessor lists software companies publish under art. 28, with what changed and when; open JSON, Markdown and an MCP server.

Related

  • PIPEDA vs GDPR: What Canadian Companies Must Know - Comparison of Canadian and EU privacy regulations for companies operating in both jurisdictions.

Games

  • VCraft (⭐6) - A voxel sandbox game written entirely in V with procedural terrain, biomes, water, mining/building, and a hotbar HUD.

📚 Literature / Scientific Research

  • 🎓 Building a smart and automated tool for packed malware detection using machine learning (June 2020)
  • 📰 A packer identification method based on section-entropy plot (February 2026) ⭐
  • 📓 Packing induced bias in deep learning malware classifiers: A systematic experimental study (February 2026)

📦 Packers / After 2010

  • HimitsuShell (⭐68) - A shell script protector that converts shell scripts into binaries with an embedded interpreter, obfuscation, and anti-debug protections (shc alternative).

  • XVolkolak (⭐4) - Qt/CMake emulator-unpacker project with a GUI and a console application.

MVC Frameworks and Libraries / Runner

  • pion (⭐131) - React Hooks API for standard web components with lit-html.

Advanced Console UIs

  • eyez (⭐1) - eyez is a handy CLI tool that lets you view images directly in your terminal, with support for most terminal emulators.

Networking

  • telepath (⭐3) - telepath is a powerful CLI tool for secure port forwarding with support for multiple jump hosts and flexible authentication.

Security

  • certifier (⭐1) - Library and CLI for generating and validating X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, CRLs, and OCSP responses.

Video

  • onvif-go (⭐40) - ONVIF client, WS-Discovery and virtual camera server for IP cameras.

  • gocondense (⭐19) - A gofmt-compatible formatter that condenses multi-line constructs onto single lines where they fit.

#### [1. Awesome Preact](/content/preactjs/awesome-preact/README.md)

##### Contents / Boilerplates

*   [Extension.js Templates (⭐12)](https://github.com/extension-js/examples) - Preact starters for popup, new tab, content script and devtools pages, ready to run in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

##### Contents / Components

*   [@zikojs/preact-console (⭐22)](https://github.com/zikojs/console/tree/main/packages/integrations/preact) - A console-like UI component for Preact that renders JavaScript console output directly inside your application.

#### [2. Awesome Storybook](/content/lauthieb/awesome-storybook/README.md)

##### Community resources

*   [Sherlo](https://sherlo.io) - Visual regression testing for React Native, integrated with Storybook; renders on iOS and Android simulators in the cloud.

##### Examples

*   [Bestax - Storybook](https://bestax.io/storybook/)

#### [3. Awesome Cytodata](/content/cytodata/awesome-cytodata/README.md)

##### 🌟 Purpose

*   **Centralize Knowledge**: Provide a "one-stop shop" for foundational and state-of-the-art research.
*   **Lower Entry Barriers**: Help new researchers navigate "Influential Papers" selected by the community.
*   **Promote Open Science**: Highlight publicly available datasets and open-source pipelines.
*   **Standardize Discovery**: Offer a professional, searchable index for DOIs and software repositories.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 📚 The Literature Corpus

*   **Advanced Search**: Real-time fuzzy searching via [Fuse.js](https://www.fusejs.io/) across titles, authors, journals, and abstracts.
*   **Author Formatting**: Scientific citation style (`Lastname, F. et al.`) for professional scanning.
*   **Filtering**: Sort by year, category (Methods, Biology, Reviews, etc.), or influential status.
*   **Direct Access**: One-click DOI links to publisher pages.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 💾 Dataset Index

*   A curated table of massive public releases like the **Cell Painting Gallery**, **JUMP-CP**, and **RxRx**.
*   Filterable by description and reference paper.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   Catalog of community-standard tools including **CellProfiler**, **DeepProfiler**, and **PyCytominer**.
*   Categorized by purpose (Feature Extraction, Data Engineering, etc.).

##### 🛠️ Technical Architecture / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   **Frontend**: React 19+ (ESM-based via CDN for zero-install development).
*   **Styling**: Tailwind CSS for a clean, academic aesthetic.
*   **Search Engine**: Fuse.js for client-side fuzzy indexing of JSON data.
*   **Data Layer**: Flat JSON files in `/data/` acting as a "Local Database" for easy community contributions.
*   **Deployment**: Automated GitHub Actions workflow for validation and hosting.

##### 🤝 Contributing / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   Read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cytodata/awesome-cytodata/blob/master/readme.md/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.

##### Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

Files stay on your device; sheets come with Aseprite-format JSON.

#### [15. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### Commands & Extensions

*   [NotWorking (⭐1)](https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking) - Downdetector for AI agents: a skill and remote MCP server that checks whether other agents report the same site, skill or MCP server failure, and takes failure reports. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking`.

#### [16. Awesome Rust](/content/rust-unofficial/awesome-rust/README.md)

##### Applications / Image processing

*   [storytold/vectorcraft (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator, built in pure Rust.

##### Applications / Productivity

*   [burakdede/aisw (⭐124)](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw) \[[aisw](https://crates.io/crates/aisw)] - Switch Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts with named profiles, cross-tool contexts and per-repository account guards [![CI](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

##### Applications / Video

*   [storytold/effectcraft (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects, built in pure Rust.

##### Libraries / Data processing

*   [faucet-hq/faucet-stream (⭐16)](https://github.com/faucet-hq/faucet-stream) \[[faucet-core](https://crates.io/crates/faucet-core)] - ETL that governs your data while it moves: a config-driven data-movement platform with pluggable source and sink connectors, CDC, in-flight masking and quality checks, run from YAML by a single binary or embedded as a library [![CI](https://github.com/faucet-hq/faucet-stream/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/faucet-hq/faucet-stream/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

AI-assisted. * [guanchzhou/zig-diffuse (⭐0)](https://github.com/guanchzhou/zig-diffuse) - Re-ranking of retrieval scores by diffusion on link and nearest-neighbor graphs. AI-assisted. * [guanchzhou/zig-lsh (⭐0)](https://github.com/guanchzhou/zig-lsh) - Cross-polytope and hyperplane LSH with multi-probe for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted. * [guanchzhou/zig-rabitq (⭐0)](https://github.com/guanchzhou/zig-rabitq) - RaBitQ one- to eight-bit vector codes with error bounds for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted. * [guanchzhou/zig-pq (⭐0)](https://github.com/guanchzhou/zig-pq) - Product quantization, k-means, and IVF-PQ for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted. #### [7.   • AimDB (⭐101) - Typed, versioned data contracts over MQTT from no_std microcontrollers (Embassy) to the cloud (Tokio), with schema migrations at the hub.

12. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Boardgame

  • Parlour (⭐6) - Deterministic TypeScript card-game engine with a cozy browser table for Blitz and Wild.

13. Awesome Rails

Gems / Other external resources

  • solid_objects (⭐40) - A gem for SQL-backed virtual actors: durable state, ordered calls, and reminders in the app's SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL database (pre-1.0). 🔴

14. Awesome Mac

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • Farol (⭐3) - Terminal built on libghostty that shows which coding agent is working, waiting or done.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Sesame (⭐5) - Open-source app that indexes the dashboards, reports, sites, PRs, and files Claude Code and Codex delivered, and reopens them when you type or say a few words.
  • Quail - Local model server for GGUF and MLX models on Apple silicon, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs for tools like Claude Code and Codex.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Mooziac - Lightweight native macOS menu bar player for YouTube Music & local audio.

15. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • bashate (⭐399) — Code style enforcement for bash programs. The output format aims to follow pycodestyle (pep8) default output format.

16. Awesome Go

CLI & Terminal / Standard CLI

  • peterh/liner (⭐1.1k) — Pure Go line editor with history, inspired by linenoise ☆1,098

Scripting / Code Generators

  • dave/jennifer (⭐3.6k) — Code generator for Go ☆3,631

17. Awesome Mac

System Tools / System Utilities

  • tamia6/AppDuo (⭐98) — Native macOS app cloner with custom names, icons, and separate data directories. ☆106

18. Magictools

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Remove Audio Noise Remover - Clean hiss, hum, wind and crowd noise out of voice lines, dialogue and trailer voice-overs with AI, free in the browser (optional paid Cloud mode for long files).

19. Awesome Rust

Applications / Graphics

  • storytold/cadcraft (⭐617) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk AutoCAD, built in pure Rust.

Applications / Image processing

  • storytold/lightcraft (⭐4.9k) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom in pure Rust.

20. Awesome Claude Code

Documentation, Knowledge & Learning / Data Visualization

  • Archify (⭐79k) by tt-a1i - An Agent Skill for Claude Code that generates interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML. Typed JSON, local renderers, and delivery checks support source-linked node details, path tracing, themes, and export.\       

Design & UI/UX / Data Visualization

  • Logo Designer Skill (⭐143) by neonwatty - Create and evolve SVG logos with Claude Code. Turns a project brief into distinct concepts you can compare side by side, then guides refinement, checks favicon legibility, and exports production-ready PNGs.\       

Agent Orchestration / Data Visualization

  • OpenRig (⭐5.9k) by Mike Schwarz - Combines Claude Code, Codex, and Pi terminal sessions into persistent long-running teams. Agents message each other directly over tmux and queue work to each other, instead of the user relaying messages. Teams and agents are saved as YAML files, and a running team can be snapshotted and restored later.\       

Configuration / Observability

  • claude-code-zsh-completion (⭐13) by 1160054 - Zsh completion for the Claude Code CLI. Dynamically completes sessions, MCP servers, agents, models and plugins from the user's configuration.\       
  • clausona (⭐49) by larcane97 - A CLI and TUI for running several Claude Code accounts on one machine. Each account gets its own config directory through a shell hook, keeping its own sign-in and history, while plugins, settings, skills, commands and agents are symlinked to one primary directory.\       

21. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Data Manipulation

  • polynx (⭐3) - Pandas-style query, eval, assign and group-by on string expressions, compiled to native Polars expressions with @var substitution, UDFs and LazyFrame support by @LowellWinston.
