items.content_text: #### [1. Awesome Chrome Devtools](/content/ChromeDevTools/awesome-chrome-devtools/README.md) ##### Tracing & Profiling * [trace.cafe](https://trace.cafe/) - Share and view web performance traces directly in the DevTools Performance panel ([source (⭐142)](https://github.com/paulirish/trace.cafe)). * [speedscope (⭐6.8k)](https://github.com/jlfwong/speedscope) - Fast, interactive flamegraph viewer that imports Chrome `.cpuprofile` and timeline traces. * [cpupro (⭐788)](https://github.com/discoveryjs/cpupro) - Deep V8/Chrome `.cpuprofile` analyzer with flamegraphs, call trees, and hot-spot diagnostics. * [Perfetto (⭐6.6k)](https://github.com/google/perfetto) - System profiling and trace analysis suite ([ui.perfetto.dev](https://ui.perfetto.dev/)) with Chromium trace support and SQL trace querying. ##### Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries * [Puppeteer (⭐96k)](https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer) - High-level Node.js API for controlling Chrome over CDP and WebDriver BiDi. See also [awesome-puppeteer (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/transitive-bullshit/awesome-puppeteer). ##### Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above) * Rust: [chromiumoxide (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/mattsse/chromiumoxide) - Async/tokio library with generated types * Rust: [Rust Headless Chrome (⭐3k)](https://github.com/rust-headless-chrome/rust-headless-chrome) - High-level headless Chrome client * Python: [Zendriver (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/cdpdriver/zendriver) - Async CDP browser automation * Ruby: [Ferrum (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/rubycdp/ferrum) - High-level API to control Chrome * Ruby: [Cuprite (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/rubycdp/cuprite) - Capybara driver * Kotlin: [kdriver (⭐108)](https://github.com/cdpdriver/kdriver) - High-level coroutine-based automation ##### Chrome DevTools Protocol / Agentic Browser Automation * [chrome-devtools-mcp (⭐53k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp) - Official MCP server for Chrome DevTools, which also includes a [CLI (⭐53k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/blob/main/skills/chrome-devtools-cli/SKILL.md). * [Webcmd (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/agentrhq/webcmd) - Compiles site navigation into deterministic per-site CLI commands for AI agents. * [bdg (⭐152)](https://github.com/szymdzum/browser-debugger-cli) - Persistent background CDP session exposing DOM, network, console, and raw protocol methods as shell commands. ##### Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters * [ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend (⭐4.1k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend) - Canonical source repo for the Chrome DevTools UI (published to npm as [chrome-devtools-frontend](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chrome-devtools-frontend)). * [Chii (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/liriliri/chii) & [Eruda (⭐21k)](https://github.com/liriliri/eruda) - Remote debugging server using the real `devtools-frontend` UI (`Chii`, a modern Weinre replacement) and in-page mobile DevTools console (`Eruda`). * [vscode-js-debug (⭐2k)](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-js-debug) - Official DAP-compliant JavaScript and Chrome CDP debugger powering VS Code. ##### DevTools Extensions / Browser Adapters * [Vue.js Developer Tools (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/vuejs/devtools) - Inspect Vue.js components, state, and routing. ##### Alumni / Browser Adapters * [noice-json-rpc (⭐46)](https://github.com/nojvek/noice-json-rpc) - Proxy-based TypeScript/JS library exposing CDP domains directly as an API. #### [2. Awesome Ada](/content/ohenley/awesome-ada/README.md) ##### Open source / GPL (with linking exception) * [gnat-patches (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/gnat-patches) - Curated GCC/GNAT patchsets against checksum-pinned upstream sources, each backed by an executable regression, published as patched native toolchain builds for GCC 13 through 16. ##### Runtimes / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) - Experimental GNAT runtime extension for ordinary Ada tasking, adding task-aware I/O and an opt-in lightweight lane that runs designated tasks as fibers on shared event loops. ##### Distributed / GPL (no linking exception) * [ipfs (⭐0)](https://github.com/kokhlo/ipfs) - InterPlanetary File System client library: CID/multihash/multibase, CAR archives with block verification, trustless HTTP gateway client. ##### Terminal User Interface / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-tui (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-tui) - Typed, declarative terminal user-interface toolkit for Ada. ##### Database / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-postgres (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-postgres) - Client and server primitives for the PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol, built on [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) task-aware I/O. ##### Web / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-http (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http) - HTTP/1.1 clients and servers with opt-in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 engines and WebSocket support, built on [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) task-aware I/O. ##### Algorithms, Containers and Protocols / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-allocators (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_allocators) - Caller-owned buddy, best-fit, TLSF, and slab/span allocation algorithms with no hosted operating system dependency. * [flyology-cachelines (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_cachelines) - Cache-line-aware storage, ownership-aware groups, grouped arrays, and host cache queries. ##### Format Readers, Writers and Checkers / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-iri (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http/tree/main/flyology_iri) - Allocation-conscious URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parsing. * [flyology-rdf (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-rdf) - RDF 1.2 terms, streaming Turtle, TriG, N-Triples and N-Quads parsing, RDFC-1.0 dataset canonicalization, Notation3, and SPARQL 1.1 query syntax. ##### Networking and Communication Middleware / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-quic (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http/tree/main/flyology_quic) - Experimental bounded QUIC transport with protocol state, streams, loss recovery, and congestion control. ##### General Purpose Computing / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-simd (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-simd) - Portable, strongly typed SIMD foundations for Ada. ##### Utilities / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-bench (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_bench) - Adaptive microbenchmarking with balanced comparisons, diagnostics, baselines, and machine-readable reports. * [flyology-debug (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_debug) - Bounded in-memory tracing, producer shards, retained batches, and persistent gauges. ##### Linux and POSIX / GPL (no linking exception) * [flyology-numa (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_numa) - Memory-node topology reporting, memory placement on a chosen node, and node-bound storage pools. #### [3. Awesome Embedded Rust](/content/rust-embedded/awesome-embedded-rust/README.md) ##### Tools / Paid and commercially available materials * [npnp (⭐34)](https://github.com/ref42/npnp) CLI tool for batch-exporting LCSC/EasyEDA components to KiCad and Altium Designer libraries. ##### Firmware projects / WIP * [oreboot (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/oreboot/oreboot): platform initialization firmware (first code to run) to bring up application processors, a fork of coreboot with no C, all written in Rust, leveraging Rust Embedded traits and crates #### [4. Awesome Opentofu](/content/virtualroot/awesome-opentofu/README.md) ##### Tools / CI * [c3x (⭐33)](https://github.com/c3xdev/c3x) - Cost estimates for OpenTofu code, including `.tofu` files and provider `for_each`, posted as a pull request comment. * [pre-commit-terraform (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/antonbabenko/pre-commit-terraform) - Collection of pre-commit git hooks for validating, formatting, and documenting Terraform and OpenTofu code. ##### Tools / Tests * [Checkov (⭐9.1k)](https://github.com/bridgecrewio/checkov) - Static analysis tool that scans Terraform and OpenTofu templates for security and compliance misconfigurations. * [KICS (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/Checkmarx/kics) - Open-source static analysis tool that finds security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in IaC, including OpenTofu. ##### Tools / State * [tfautomv (⭐898)](https://github.com/busser/tfautomv) - CLI that automatically generates `moved` blocks and state-move commands for refactoring Terraform/OpenTofu configurations. * [terraform-tui (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/idoavrah/terraform-tui) - Terminal UI for browsing, applying, and managing Terraform/OpenTofu state and plans interactively. ##### Tools / Helpers * [TerraVision (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/patrickchugh/terravision) - Generate cloud architecture diagrams with official AWS, Azure and GCP icons from OpenTofu or Terraform code. #### [5. Awesome Cpp](/content/fffaraz/awesome-cpp/README.md) ##### Coding Style Tools * [cpp-linter-hooks (⭐50)](https://github.com/cpp-linter/cpp-linter-hooks) - Pre-commit hooks for C/C++ powered by clang-format and clang-tidy. \[MIT] #### [6. Awesome Go](/content/avelino/awesome-go/README.md) ##### DevOps Tools / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares * [Spinifex (⭐346)](https://github.com/mulgadc/spinifex) - Self-hosted, AWS-compatible cloud platform providing EC2, EBS, S3, VPC and IAM APIs for bare-metal, edge and on-premises infrastructure. #### [7. Collective Ai Tools](/content/Hyraze/collective-ai-tools/README.md) ##### Developer Tools * [Orbi](https://orbi.build/?ref=oss-collective-ai-tools) - Open-source agent that takes a labeled GitHub issue to a reviewed, merged pull request and a tagged release; also runs ops tickets. `#freemium` `#opensource` ##### Fashion * [TryOnSwap](https://tryonswap.com/en) - Creates AI fashion previews from model photos and garment references, with single-item or up-to-five-piece outfits; paid credit packs and introductory credits after email verification. `#paid` ##### Finance * [FXMacroData](https://fxmacrodata.com/) - Official-source macroeconomic releases, release calendars, central bank rates and FX data for 22 currencies, served over a REST API and a hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants; USD data works without a key. `#freemium` `#mcp` * [Invompt](https://invompt.com/) - Turns work from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor into invoices, quotes, and estimates you review before sending, through the hosted MCP at `https://mcp.invompt.com/mcp`. You can try it as a guest, with no account. `#free` ##### Music * [Songifted](https://songifted.com/) - Creates personalized AI song gifts from names and memories, with lyrics approval before recording, a free 45-second preview, and paid full songs. `#paid` ##### Travel * [SkyAccess MCP (⭐1)](https://github.com/sky-access/skyaccess-mcp) - Search 5,000+ live empty leg flights, get charter price estimates and booking links. No account or API key. `#free` `#mcp` #### [8. Awesome Osint](/content/jivoi/awesome-osint/README.md) ##### Social Media Tools / Telegram * [tg-chat-dump (⭐3)](https://github.com/renkagod/tg-chat-dump) - Archives a whole Telegram group, channel or forum into a searchable SQLite database and per-topic text and JSONL files, at 100k+ messages a minute in Telegram's export mode. Filters by date, author and message type. #### [9. Awesome Neovim](/content/rockerBOO/awesome-neovim/README.md) ##### Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX * [daaanny90/zed.nvim (⭐0)](https://github.com/daaanny90/zed.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][Lua]`*** Zed editor look with six dark variants, plus tmux and iTerm2 extras. * [daaanny90/claude-desktop.nvim (⭐2)](https://github.com/daaanny90/claude-desktop.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][Lua]`*** Warm dark colorscheme matching the Claude Desktop app, with tmux and iTerm2 extras. * [daaanny90/iterm2-dark-background.nvim (⭐0)](https://github.com/daaanny90/iterm2-dark-background.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][Lua]`*** Muted dark colorscheme inspired by iTerm2's Dark Background preset. * [oxidescheme/nvim (⭐18)](https://github.com/oxidescheme/nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][Lua]`*** Minimalist dark colorscheme built on an OKLCH palette with a monochrome-first UI. #### [10. Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md) ##### Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing * [IPTVMac](https://goelir.github.io/IPTVMac/) - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U with instant search, mpv playback, Picture in Picture and downloads. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Goelir/IPTVMac) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") #### [11. Awesome Python](/content/vinta/awesome-python/README.md) ##### **Sponsors** * [iPulse AI](https://ipulseai.com) - Open Agentic Investment Research Platform. Inspect deep multi-agent market forecasts and stock picks. #### [12. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md) ##### Collections / Voxel Editors * :free: [SFXMint](https://sfxmint.com/) - CC0 game and UI sound effects in WAV/MP3; AI-generated or procedurally synthesized, with no signup required for library downloads. ##### Ads / Voxel Editors * :tada: [Bounty Board Arcade SDK](https://www.bountyboard.gg/arcade/sdk) - Rewarded ads, leaderboards and cloud saves for HTML5 games published on the Bounty Board Arcade. #### [13. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md) ##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools * [puenteo (⭐1)](https://github.com/mano7onam/puenteo) - Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon. ##### Commands & Extensions * [figma-maxxing (⭐8)](https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing) - Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing`. ##### Development Tools & Utilities * [fakegreen (⭐2)](https://github.com/fitzyracing1/fakegreen) - Deterministic diff checker with an `AfterAgent` hook (`npx fakegreen install gemini`) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with `|| true`, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT. ##### MCP Servers * [MAQAMI Travel (⭐2)](https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server) - Hotel and flight search and booking from Gemini CLI: search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the offer they choose. Remote Streamable HTTP (`https://mcp.maqami.co/`), no sign-in or API key. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server`. #### [14. Awesome Rust](/content/rust-unofficial/awesome-rust/README.md) ##### Applications / Database * [aimdb-dev/aimdb (⭐101)](https://github.com/aimdb-dev/aimdb) \[[aimdb-core](https://crates.io/crates/aimdb-core)] - Data ingestion layer for distributed systems with typed contracts, safe schema evolution and one place to see and manage every node, from microcontroller to cloud. [![CI](https://github.com/aimdb-dev/aimdb/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/aimdb-dev/aimdb/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ##### Applications / Productivity * [leepokai/Codync (⭐176)](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync) - A host that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other ACP coding agents as persistent bots you message from an iPhone, desktop app or terminal UI (ratatui) [![build badge](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync/actions/workflows/host.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync/actions/workflows/host.yml) #### [15. Awesome Claude Code](/content/hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code/README.md) ##### Documentation, Knowledge & Learning * [learn-faster-kit (⭐382)](https://github.com/hluaguo/learn-faster-kit) by [Hugo Lau](https://github.com/hluaguo) - A creative educational framework for Claude Code, inspired by the "FASTER" approach to self-teaching. Ships with a variety of agents, slash commands, and tools that enable Claude Code to help you progress at your own pace, employing well-established pedagogical techniques like active learning and spaced repetition.\        ##### Documentation, Knowledge & Learning / Obsidian * [vir (⭐16)](https://github.com/djolex999/vir) by [Djordje Marković](https://github.com/djolex999) - Distills the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk into typed markdown notes (decisions, gotchas, patterns). Serves them via MCP and a CLAUDE.md block. Integrates with Obsidian.\        ##### Research & Scientific Inquiry / Data Visualization * [Claude Scientific Skills (⭐48k)](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills) by [K-Dense](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI) - "A set of ready-to-use Agent Skills for research, science, engineering, analysis, finance and writing." That's their description - modest, simple. That's how you can tell this is really one of the best skills repos on GitHub. If you've ever thought about getting a PhD... just read all of these documents instead. Also I think it IS an AI agent or something? Awesome.\        ##### Providers, Runtime & Integration Infrastructure / Data Visualization * [SPARDA (⭐8)](https://github.com/zakariagharzouli/sparda) by [Zakaria Gharzouli (Residual Labs)](https://github.com/zakariagharzouli) - Converts a running Express or FastAPI app into an MCP server by AST-parsing its routes and injecting a marked, byte-for-byte-removable `/mcp` router, so the agent can operate your live application (real auth, real data) rather than just read files. Exceptionally safety-minded: writes are disabled by default behind two-phase confirmation, docstrings are sanitized against prompt injection, a circuit-breaker quarantines failing routes, nothing leaves the machine, and persistence stores structure never payloads.\        ##### Remote Control, Notifications & Voice I/O / Data Visualization * [anotifier (⭐30)](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/anotifier-for-claude-codex-cursor) by [Amin Dhouib (Devino Solutions)](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions) - A zero-dependency, cross-platform notifier that fires a desktop toast and a free phone push (via ntfy) the moment Claude Code (or Codex/Cursor/Gemini) finishes a task or needs input, wired up by a one-command setup. The standout among notifiers is its testing rigor — CI drives the *real* agent CLIs end to end and asserts real ntfy round-trips and real OS toast delivery, no mocks.\        * [Claude CLI ↔ Telegram (⭐36)](https://github.com/Imolatte/claude-cli-telegram) by [Imolatte](https://github.com/Imolatte) - A feature-rich Telegram bot that turns your machine into a remote Claude Code terminal driven from your phone: streaming tool progress, voice input, a git panel, Mac remote control, and 30+ commands. Its standout is the approval flow — dangerous-op Approve/Deny taps are injected straight into the real terminal prompt via `tmux send-keys`, so you authorize from your phone without killing the session or losing context.\        ##### Alternative Clients / Data Visualization * [Agent Workbench (⭐7)](https://github.com/cvelasquez/agent-workbench) by [cvelasquez](https://github.com/cvelasquez) - Local web UI that runs the unmodified Claude Code CLI in a pseudo-terminal and adds tabs, a browsable history of past sessions, conversations rendered as cards, a context meter, and the agent's multiple-choice questions answered from the UI.\        ##### Writing & Prose Quality / Data Visualization * [oh-my-patent (⭐103)](https://github.com/illusionaireal/oh-my-patent) by [illusionaireal](https://github.com/illusionaireal) - A plugin for turning technical ideas into patent disclosures.\        * [Scientific Writing Skills (⭐3)](https://github.com/dvdsosa/scientific-writing-skills) by [David Sosa-Trejo](https://github.com/dvdsosa) - Six Agent Skills for scientific writing based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences course: sentence-level prose editing, IMRaD manuscript structure, the writing process, peer review and publication, grants and recommendation letters, and lay summaries and press. 1. Awesome Chrome Devtools

Tracing & Profiling

  • trace.cafe - Share and view web performance traces directly in the DevTools Performance panel (source (⭐142)).
  • speedscope (⭐6.8k) - Fast, interactive flamegraph viewer that imports Chrome .cpuprofile and timeline traces.
  • cpupro (⭐788) - Deep V8/Chrome .cpuprofile analyzer with flamegraphs, call trees, and hot-spot diagnostics.
  • Perfetto (⭐6.6k) - System profiling and trace analysis suite (ui.perfetto.dev) with Chromium trace support and SQL trace querying.

Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries

  • Puppeteer (⭐96k) - High-level Node.js API for controlling Chrome over CDP and WebDriver BiDi. See also awesome-puppeteer (⭐2.6k).

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

  • Rust: chromiumoxide (⭐1.4k) - Async/tokio library with generated types
  • Rust: Rust Headless Chrome (⭐3k) - High-level headless Chrome client
  • Python: Zendriver (⭐1.5k) - Async CDP browser automation
  • Ruby: Ferrum (⭐2.1k) - High-level API to control Chrome
  • Ruby: Cuprite (⭐1.4k) - Capybara driver
  • Kotlin: kdriver (⭐108) - High-level coroutine-based automation

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Agentic Browser Automation

  • chrome-devtools-mcp (⭐53k) - Official MCP server for Chrome DevTools, which also includes a CLI (⭐53k).
  • Webcmd (⭐2.6k) - Compiles site navigation into deterministic per-site CLI commands for AI agents.
  • bdg (⭐152) - Persistent background CDP session exposing DOM, network, console, and raw protocol methods as shell commands.

Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

  • ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend (⭐4.1k) - Canonical source repo for the Chrome DevTools UI (published to npm as chrome-devtools-frontend).
  • Chii (⭐2.2k) & Eruda (⭐21k) - Remote debugging server using the real devtools-frontend UI (Chii, a modern Weinre replacement) and in-page mobile DevTools console (Eruda).
  • vscode-js-debug (⭐2k) - Official DAP-compliant JavaScript and Chrome CDP debugger powering VS Code.

DevTools Extensions / Browser Adapters

  • Vue.js Developer Tools (⭐2.9k) - Inspect Vue.js components, state, and routing.

Alumni / Browser Adapters

  • noice-json-rpc (⭐46) - Proxy-based TypeScript/JS library exposing CDP domains directly as an API.

2. Awesome Ada

Open source / GPL (with linking exception)

  • gnat-patches (⭐0) - Curated GCC/GNAT patchsets against checksum-pinned upstream sources, each backed by an executable regression, published as patched native toolchain builds for GCC 13 through 16.

Runtimes / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology (⭐9) - Experimental GNAT runtime extension for ordinary Ada tasking, adding task-aware I/O and an opt-in lightweight lane that runs designated tasks as fibers on shared event loops.

Distributed / GPL (no linking exception)

  • ipfs (⭐0) - InterPlanetary File System client library: CID/multihash/multibase, CAR archives with block verification, trustless HTTP gateway client.

Terminal User Interface / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-tui (⭐0) - Typed, declarative terminal user-interface toolkit for Ada.

Database / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-postgres (⭐0) - Client and server primitives for the PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol, built on flyology (⭐9) task-aware I/O.

Web / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-http (⭐0) - HTTP/1.1 clients and servers with opt-in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 engines and WebSocket support, built on flyology (⭐9) task-aware I/O.

Algorithms, Containers and Protocols / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-allocators (⭐9) - Caller-owned buddy, best-fit, TLSF, and slab/span allocation algorithms with no hosted operating system dependency.
  • flyology-cachelines (⭐9) - Cache-line-aware storage, ownership-aware groups, grouped arrays, and host cache queries.

Format Readers, Writers and Checkers / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-iri (⭐0) - Allocation-conscious URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parsing.
  • flyology-rdf (⭐0) - RDF 1.2 terms, streaming Turtle, TriG, N-Triples and N-Quads parsing, RDFC-1.0 dataset canonicalization, Notation3, and SPARQL 1.1 query syntax.

Networking and Communication Middleware / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-quic (⭐0) - Experimental bounded QUIC transport with protocol state, streams, loss recovery, and congestion control.

General Purpose Computing / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-simd (⭐0) - Portable, strongly typed SIMD foundations for Ada.

Utilities / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-bench (⭐9) - Adaptive microbenchmarking with balanced comparisons, diagnostics, baselines, and machine-readable reports.
  • flyology-debug (⭐9) - Bounded in-memory tracing, producer shards, retained batches, and persistent gauges.

Linux and POSIX / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-numa (⭐9) - Memory-node topology reporting, memory placement on a chosen node, and node-bound storage pools.

3. Awesome Embedded Rust

Tools / Paid and commercially available materials

  • npnp (⭐34) CLI tool for batch-exporting LCSC/EasyEDA components to KiCad and Altium Designer libraries.

Firmware projects / WIP

  • oreboot (⭐1.8k): platform initialization firmware (first code to run) to bring up application processors, a fork of coreboot with no C, all written in Rust, leveraging Rust Embedded traits and crates

4. Awesome Opentofu

Tools / CI

  • c3x (⭐33) - Cost estimates for OpenTofu code, including .tofu files and provider for_each, posted as a pull request comment.
  • pre-commit-terraform (⭐3.8k) - Collection of pre-commit git hooks for validating, formatting, and documenting Terraform and OpenTofu code.

Tools / Tests

  • Checkov (⭐9.1k) - Static analysis tool that scans Terraform and OpenTofu templates for security and compliance misconfigurations.
  • KICS (⭐2.7k) - Open-source static analysis tool that finds security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in IaC, including OpenTofu.

Tools / State

  • tfautomv (⭐898) - CLI that automatically generates moved blocks and state-move commands for refactoring Terraform/OpenTofu configurations.
  • terraform-tui (⭐1.3k) - Terminal UI for browsing, applying, and managing Terraform/OpenTofu state and plans interactively.

Tools / Helpers

  • TerraVision (⭐1.6k) - Generate cloud architecture diagrams with official AWS, Azure and GCP icons from OpenTofu or Terraform code.

Coding Style Tools

  • cpp-linter-hooks (⭐50) - Pre-commit hooks for C/C++ powered by clang-format and clang-tidy. [MIT]

DevOps Tools / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares

  • Orbi - Open-source agent that takes a labeled GitHub issue to a reviewed, merged pull request and a tagged release; also runs ops tickets. #freemium #opensource

Fashion

  • TryOnSwap - Creates AI fashion previews from model photos and garment references, with single-item or up-to-five-piece outfits; paid credit packs and introductory credits after email verification. #paid

Finance

  • FXMacroData - Official-source macroeconomic releases, release calendars, central bank rates and FX data for 22 currencies, served over a REST API and a hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants; USD data works without a key. #freemium #mcp
  • Invompt - Turns work from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor into invoices, quotes, and estimates you review before sending, through the hosted MCP at https://mcp.invompt.com/mcp. You can try it as a guest, with no account. #free

Music

  • Songifted - Creates personalized AI song gifts from names and memories, with lyrics approval before recording, a free 45-second preview, and paid full songs. #paid

Travel

  • SkyAccess MCP (⭐1) - Search 5,000+ live empty leg flights, get charter price estimates and booking links. No account or API key. #free #mcp

8. Awesome Osint

Social Media Tools / Telegram

  • tg-chat-dump (⭐3) - Archives a whole Telegram group, channel or forum into a searchable SQLite database and per-topic text and JSONL files, at 100k+ messages a minute in Telegram's export mode. Filters by date, author and message type.

9. Awesome Neovim

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • daaanny90/zed.nvim (⭐0) - [TS][LSP][Lua] Zed editor look with six dark variants, plus tmux and iTerm2 extras.
  • daaanny90/claude-desktop.nvim (⭐2) - [TS][LSP][Lua] Warm dark colorscheme matching the Claude Desktop app, with tmux and iTerm2 extras.
  • daaanny90/iterm2-dark-background.nvim (⭐0) - [TS][LSP][Lua] Muted dark colorscheme inspired by iTerm2's Dark Background preset.
  • oxidescheme/nvim (⭐18) - [TS][LSP][Lua] Minimalist dark colorscheme built on an OKLCH palette with a monochrome-first UI.

10. Awesome Mac

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • IPTVMac - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U with instant search, mpv playback, Picture in Picture and downloads.

11. Awesome Python

Sponsors

  • iPulse AI - Open Agentic Investment Research Platform. Inspect deep multi-agent market forecasts and stock picks.

12. Magictools

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 SFXMint - CC0 game and UI sound effects in WAV/MP3; AI-generated or procedurally synthesized, with no signup required for library downloads.

Ads / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 Bounty Board Arcade SDK - Rewarded ads, leaderboards and cloud saves for HTML5 games published on the Bounty Board Arcade.

13. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • puenteo (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon.

Commands & Extensions

  • figma-maxxing (⭐8) - Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing.

  • fakegreen (⭐2) - Deterministic diff checker with an AfterAgent hook (npx fakegreen install gemini) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with || true, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT.

    • Evergreen Compose supplies a shared, precompiled Android runtime. Application builds require EGCL and egcl-target-android (runtime API 4), no JDK, Kotlin compiler, Gradle, Android SDK or NDK.
    • Develop inside the running app. Connect Emacs with SLY or icl to the phone's Lisp image through an ADB-forwarded Slynk port. Evaluate Lisp, inspect application state, and update the running UI without rebuilding or reinstalling the APK

Work in progress

  • (LLM) Evergreen (⭐21): Evergreen is Common Lisp with a HotSpot-inspired native runtime, built from scratch in Rust. It starts executing in bytecode, compiles hot code to native instructions, and specializes dynamically typed programs as they run.
    • new as of Oct, 2026
    • warning: this is an experiment. The parts that do work may not behave the way you expect, or the way the standard says they should. It may never work.
    • Lightweight fibers with synchronous socket I/O
    • Native interoperability (C, JVM, Python)
    • Standalone applications and saved images.
    • The default x86-64 Linux build is fully static
    • Tree shaking of Lisp and Rust
    • Native Android applications with Slime-style development: see evergreen-compose (⭐2)
    • Core code, test suites, and documentation were almost entirely generated by AI assistants following high-level human prompts and specification. Conceptual architecture, prompt direction, and repository orchestration (minimal manual code review or line-by-line verification).

8. Awesome Zig

Fundamentals / Utility

  • hgrsd/duplik - Zig-based CLI to detect duplicate files. No-AI.

Language Essentials / Command Line and Argument Parser

  • hgrsd/zopt - Low-ceremony schemaless command line argument parser for the Zig ecosystem. No-AI.

9. Awesome Go

Advanced Console UIs

  • huh (⭐7.2k) - Lightweight library for building interactive forms and prompts in the terminal.

Machine Learning

  • gorse (⭐9.8k) - An offline recommender system backend based on collaborative filtering written in Go.

Testing Frameworks

  • prettycov (⭐3) - Draws a Go coverage profile as a package tree with a total on every row.

DevOps Tools / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares

  • metricsd (⭐1) - Lightweight metrics collector with plugin system, shipping to Prometheus, Splunk HEC, and HTTP JSON endpoints.

10. Awesome Game Remakes

Adventure

  • Flipendo (⭐0) - Source port of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone and Chamber of Secrets (PC, KnowWonder) on SurrealEngine. Requires the original game files.

11. Collective Ai Tools

Fashion

  • RealFun Color - Provides selfie-based personal color analysis and checks clothing colors against a personal color profile. #freemium

12. Awesome D

Build Tools / Status page

  • rules_d (⭐27) - Bazel rules and toolchains for building D libraries, binaries, tests, protocol buffers, and projects that depend on DUB packages.
  • gazelle_d (⭐0) - Gazelle extension for generating Bazel build files from D sources and DUB manifests.

13. Webcomponents the Right Way

Component Libraries

  • Marvelous UI (⭐1) - Framework-agnostic custom elements and CSS components with design tokens and no runtime dependencies.

14. Awesome Osint

Image Search / GitHub

  • Reverse Image Search Anywhere - Free browser extension and web tool for searching images across Google Lens, Yandex, Bing Visual Search, and TinEye, including images on sites where direct image URLs fail.

Threat Intelligence / GitHub

  • Dread Scraper (⭐1) - Slow, resumable archiver for selected Dread boards, routed through Tor. Saves threads and replies to a local SQLite database with full-text search for offline threat-intelligence research.

15. Awesome Neovim

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • 2giosangmitom/nightfall.nvim (⭐49) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] Dracula-inspired colorscheme with four flavors including a light variant.

16. Public Apis

Science & Math

  • API: Oliver's mTOR Atlas

    Description: Curated mTOR research: studies by evidence type, pathway claims, open questions

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

17. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Ebooks

  • Rapid Reader (⭐1) - Open-source RSVP speed reader for EPUB, PDF, and web articles with a full-text view.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • WhisperDrop 2 (⭐0) - Open-source local transcription for audio, video, YouTube, and meetings, with dictation into any app.

Utilities / Productivity

  • OpenNaga (⭐2) - Open-source Razer Synapse alternative for the Naga V2 HyperSpeed that remaps the side buttons and sets DPI and polling rate.

18. Free for Dev

PaaS

  • velixir - EU-hosted PaaS that builds web apps from source in any language (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, Elixir, Rust, .NET and more), no Dockerfile needed. The free tier includes one app (0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM) that sleeps when idle, custom domains with TLS, and no credit card.

19. Awesome Go

CLI & Terminal / Standard CLI

  • jessevdk/go-flags (⭐2.7k) — Command-line option parser ☆2,693

20. Awesome Mac

Communication / Collaboration

  • blendbyte/Textual (⭐1.9k) — Textual is a native IRC client for macOS ☆1,915

21. Awesome Dataviz

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
  • Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
  • chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
  • ChartGPU (⭐3.2k) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
  • DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
  • ECharts GL (⭐2.7k) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
  • Flot (⭐5.9k) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
  • heatmap.js (⭐6.4k) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
  • VChart (⭐1.8k) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
  • force-graph (⭐2.1k) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
  • Viz.js (⭐4.3k) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • chartjs-chart-financial (⭐809) - Chart.js module that adds candlestick and OHLC chart types.
  • HQChart (⭐3.4k) - K-line and stock charts with a technical indicator scripting engine, for web pages and WeChat mini programs.
  • KLineChart (⭐4.2k) - Lightweight, highly customizable candlestick (k-line) chart with zero dependencies and mobile support.
  • React Financial Charts (⭐1.4k) - React components for financial charts: candlesticks, technical indicators, overlays and drawing tools.
  • TradeCanvas (⭐22) - Financial charts with indicators, drawing tools and live feeds, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL.
  • Vela (⭐992) - Financial charting library with a headless core, native WebGL2 renderer and plugin SDK, from LuxAlgo.

JavaScript tools / Maps

  • COBE (⭐5.9k) - Lightweight WebGL globe library of about 5 kB, with configurable markers.
  • mapcn (⭐12k) - Map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and compatible with shadcn/ui.
  • TerriaJS (⭐1.4k) - Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers with catalogs of map layers.

JavaScript tools / React

  • Ant Design Charts (⭐2.2k) - React chart library based on AntV, with statistical charts, graphs and maps.
  • react-force-graph (⭐3.3k) - React components for 2D, 3D, VR and AR force-directed graphs.
  • react-plotly.js (⭐1.1k) - React component for Plotly.js charts, maintained by Plotly.

JavaScript tools / React Native

  • react-native-charts-wrapper (⭐2.5k) - React Native wrapper for MPAndroidChart and DGCharts on Android and iOS.
  • react-native-gifted-charts (⭐1.4k) - Bar, line, area, pie, radar, bubble and candlestick charts for React Native, with animations.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • asciichart (⭐2.1k) - ASCII line charts for the console in Node.js and browsers, with ports to other languages.
  • Flint (⭐4.3k) - Chart specification language from Microsoft that compiles to Vega-Lite, ECharts, Chart.js or Plotly.
  • LayerChart (⭐1.3k) - Composable Svelte chart components for cartesian, radial, hierarchical, graph and geo charts.
  • ng2-charts (⭐2.4k) - Angular directives for Chart.js charts.
  • vis-timeline (⭐2.6k) - Interactive timelines and 2D graphs with items and ranges, from the vis.js project.
  • Vue Data UI (⭐2.5k) - Vue 3 component library of charts, gauges, tables and other data visualizations.

C++ tools / Misc

  • ImPlot3D (⭐1.3k) - Immediate-mode 3D plotting extension for Dear ImGui, inspired by ImPlot.
  • OpenSpace (⭐1.3k) - Interactive software for visualizing the known universe, from astronomy catalogs to space missions.
  • Serial Studio (⭐7.2k) - Real-time telemetry dashboard for data from serial ports, Bluetooth LE, network sockets and other sources.

Dashboards and BI / Misc

  • datart (⭐2.3k) - Data visualization platform for building reports, dashboards and data stories.

Julia tools / Misc

  • AlgebraOfGraphics.jl (⭐519) - Algebraic grammar-of-graphics visualization for Julia, built on Makie.

Machine Learning tools / Misc

  • Model Explorer (⭐1.6k) - Hierarchical graph visualizer and debugger for ML models, from Google.
  • NN-SVG (⭐5.7k) - Web tool for drawing publication-ready neural network architecture diagrams and exporting them to SVG.
  • VisualDL (⭐4.9k) - Deep learning visualization toolkit for metrics, graphs, embeddings and more, from PaddlePaddle.

.NET tools / Misc

  • Plotly.NET (⭐862) - Interactive charts for F# and C#, based on Plotly.js.
  • XCharts (⭐3.8k) - Charting and data visualization library for Unity, built on UGUI.

Python tools / Misc

  • fastplotlib (⭐1.5k) - GPU-accelerated plotting library built on WGPU and pygfx for fast interactive visualization.
  • hvPlot (⭐1.4k) - High-level plotting API for pandas, xarray, Dask, NetworkX and other data structures, built on HoloViews.
  • ipyleaflet (⭐1.5k) - Interactive Leaflet maps in Jupyter notebooks, built on ipywidgets.
  • LIDA (⭐3.3k) - Generates visualizations and infographics from data with large language models, from Microsoft.
  • lightweight-charts-python (⭐2.2k) - Python interface to TradingView's Lightweight Charts for financial charts.
  • Lonboard (⭐962) - Fast, interactive geospatial data visualization in Jupyter, built on deck.gl and GeoArrow.
  • mpld3 (⭐2.4k) - Renders matplotlib figures as interactive D3.js graphics in the browser.
  • prettymaps (⭐14k) - Draws stylized maps from OpenStreetMap data, using osmnx and matplotlib.
  • pygal (⭐2.8k) - SVG charting library for Python with many chart types and interactive output.
  • PyGMT (⭐875) - Python interface to the Generic Mapping Tools (GMT) for maps and figures in the geosciences.
  • scattertext (⭐2.3k) - Interactive scatterplot visualizations of how language differs between groups of documents.
  • Sweetviz (⭐3.1k) - Generates self-contained HTML reports that visualize and compare datasets for exploratory analysis.
  • termgraph (⭐3.3k) - Draws bar charts, histograms and other basic graphs in the terminal, as a CLI or Python library.
  • viser (⭐2.8k) - Web-based 3D visualization library for computer vision and robotics, with GUI building blocks.
  • Vizro (⭐3.8k) - Low-code toolkit from McKinsey for building data visualization apps and dashboards, built on Dash.

R tools / Misc

  • circlize (⭐1k) - Circular visualization in R, such as chord diagrams and Circos-style genomic plots.
  • ggiraph (⭐880) - Makes ggplot2 graphics interactive, with tooltips, hover effects and selections.
  • ggpubr (⭐1.3k) - ggplot2-based functions for publication-ready plots with statistical annotations.
  • htmlwidgets (⭐801) - Framework for binding JavaScript visualization libraries to R, for use in R Markdown and Shiny.
  • tmap (⭐909) - Thematic maps in R, with a ggplot2-like layered syntax and static or interactive output.

Markup-based tools / Misc

  • C4-PlantUML (⭐7.4k) - PlantUML macros and styles for drawing software architecture diagrams with the C4 model.
  • CeTZ (⭐1.9k) - Drawing library for Typst with a TikZ-inspired API, for diagrams and plots.
  • Flowchart Fun (⭐3.4k) - Web app that generates flowcharts and diagrams from indented text.
  • nomnoml (⭐2.8k) - Draws UML diagrams from a simple text syntax.
  • PGF/TikZ (⭐1.4k) - TeX packages for programmatically drawing vector graphics and diagrams in LaTeX.
  • Svgbob (⭐4.2k) - Converts ASCII art diagrams into SVG.

Other tools / Misc

  • GeoLibre (⭐7.8k) - Cloud-native GIS app for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data on the web, desktop and mobile.
  • GMT (⭐983) - Command-line tools for processing geographic data and making publication-quality maps and plots.
  • mcp-server-chart (⭐4.4k) - MCP server from AntV that lets AI agents generate more than 25 chart types.
  • SankeyMATIC (⭐1.4k) - Web tool for building Sankey diagrams from a plain-text description of flows.
  • sqliteviz (⭐2.4k) - Browser app that loads CSV, JSON or SQLite files, runs SQL and charts the results offline.
  • ttyplot (⭐1.4k) - Real-time terminal plotting utility that reads data from standard input.
  • uMap (⭐1.6k) - Web app for creating maps with OpenStreetMap layers and embedding them in websites.

22. Awesome Gemini Cli

API Bridges & Proxies

  • cliproxy-rs (⭐16) - Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

23. Awesome Rust

Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

  • cmccomb/rust-automl (⭐38) [automl] - Automated classification, regression, and clustering workflows built on SmartCore

Libraries / Computation

  • cmccomb/vote (⭐0) [vote] - Common preference aggregation and voting methods

Libraries / Scripting

  • cmccomb/mocktave (⭐3) [mocktave] - Run Octave or MATLAB code from Rust with native and bundled modes

Libraries / Text processing

  • cmccomb/rust-stop-words (⭐26) [stop-words] - Common stop words in many languages

24. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Validation

  • dataprof (⭐21) - Data profiling and quality gates for Polars and pandas DataFrames, CSV, JSON and Parquet, written in Rust, by @AndreaBozzo.

items.content_text:
#### [1. Awesome Django](/content/wsvincent/awesome-django/README.md)

##### Projects / Open Source Projects

*   [ioe (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/zhtyyx/ioe) - Self-hosted retail store management with inventory, sales checkout, and member accounts.

#### [2. Awesome Cyber Security University](/content/brootware/awesome-cyber-security-university/README.md)

##### Introduction and Pre-Security / Level 1 - Intro

*   [WebTerm Learn](https://learn.webterm.app/en/courses) - Free Linux command line courses where each lesson ends in hands-on exercises in a simulated terminal in the browser. A free account is needed after the first lesson.

#### [3. Open Source Flutter Apps](/content/tortuvshin/open-source-flutter-apps/README.md)

##### Productivity

*   [AFFiNE](https://openappscout.com/apps/affine/) - AFFiNE is an open-source knowledge base that merges docs, whiteboard and databases on one canvas, with local-first storage, real-time collaboration and Docker self-hosting. ([Source (⭐73k)](https://github.com/toeverything/AFFiNE))
*   [AgenticSeek](https://openappscout.com/apps/agenticseek/) - AgenticSeek is a GPL-3.0 autonomous AI agent that browses, codes and plans on your own machine with local models — a self-described local alternative to Manus. ([Source (⭐27k)](https://github.com/Fosowl/agenticSeek))
*   [Amical](https://openappscout.com/apps/amical/) - Amical is an MIT-licensed, local-first AI dictation app for macOS and Windows, with context-aware formatting, custom vocabulary and an Android app. ([Source (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/amicalhq/amical))
*   [AnythingLLM](https://openappscout.com/apps/anythingllm/) - AnythingLLM is an MIT-licensed AI workspace for macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker that lets you chat with your own documents and run agents with a local or cloud model. ([Source (⭐67k)](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm))
*   [Baserow](https://openappscout.com/apps/baserow/) - Baserow is an open-core, self-hostable no-code database and app builder whose open-source edition is MIT-licensed, with a hosted cloud at baserow\.io. ([Source (⭐6.1k)](https://github.com/baserow/baserow))
*   [Eigent](https://openappscout.com/apps/eigent/) - Eigent is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that splits work across several AI agents running in parallel, with any model including local ones. ([Source (⭐15k)](https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent))
*   [Excalidraw](https://openappscout.com/apps/excalidraw/) - Excalidraw is an MIT-licensed virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn-style diagrams, with end-to-end encrypted live collaboration, local-first autosave and a React component for embedding. ([Source (⭐133k)](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw))
*   [Flow Launcher](https://openappscout.com/apps/flow-launcher/) - Flow Launcher is an MIT-licensed keyboard launcher for Windows 10 and 11 with fast file search, a preview panel and a large plugin ecosystem. ([Source (⭐16k)](https://github.com/Flow-Launcher/Flow.Launcher))
*   [FluidVoice](https://openappscout.com/apps/fluidvoice/) - FluidVoice is a free, GPL-3.0 macOS dictation app that transcribes on-device with very low latency and optionally cleans up text with a cloud or local model. ([Source (⭐12k)](https://github.com/altic-dev/FluidVoice))
*   [Formbricks](https://openappscout.com/apps/formbricks/) - Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform — link, website, in-app and email surveys — that you can self-host with Docker or use as a cloud service. ([Source (⭐13k)](https://github.com/formbricks/formbricks))
*   [FreeFlow](https://openappscout.com/apps/freeflow/) - FreeFlow is an MIT-licensed Mac dictation app that transcribes and cleans up speech with Groq or any OpenAI-compatible provider you configure, with no FreeFlow server in between. ([Source (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/zachlatta/freeflow))
*   [Grist](https://openappscout.com/apps/grist/) - Grist is an Apache-licensed relational spreadsheet that combines spreadsheet formulas with database structure, self-hostable with Docker and available as a desktop app. ([Source (⭐12k)](https://github.com/gristlabs/grist-core))
*   [Handy](https://openappscout.com/apps/handy/) - Handy is an MIT-licensed, fully offline dictation app for Windows, macOS and Linux that types what you say into any text field using Whisper or Parakeet on your own machine. ([Source (⭐33k)](https://github.com/cjpais/Handy))
*   [HeyForm](https://openappscout.com/apps/heyform/) - HeyForm is an AGPL-licensed, self-hostable builder for conversational forms, surveys, quizzes and polls, with logic, theming, analytics and integrations. ([Source (⭐9k)](https://github.com/heyform/heyform))
*   [It's a Plan](https://openappscout.com/apps/itsaplan/) - It's a Plan is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted project management and issue tracking app where AI agents take issues on the same board as people, with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server. ([Source (⭐883)](https://github.com/croffasia/itsaplan))
*   [Jan](https://openappscout.com/apps/jan/) - Jan is an Apache-2.0 desktop app that runs open LLMs offline on your own computer, with optional cloud models, custom assistants, MCP and a local OpenAI-compatible server. ([Source (⭐45k)](https://github.com/janhq/jan))
*   [Kanboard](https://openappscout.com/apps/kanboard/) - Kanboard is an MIT-licensed Kanban project management app that focuses on simplicity, with WIP limits, automatic actions and a small PHP footprint. ([Source (⭐9.9k)](https://github.com/kanboard/kanboard))
*   [Kaneo](https://openappscout.com/apps/kaneo/) - Kaneo is an MIT-licensed, self-hostable project management app with boards, lists, calendars and Gantt charts, GitHub and Gitea integration, a REST API and MCP. ([Source (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/usekaneo/kaneo))
*   [Khoj](https://openappscout.com/apps/khoj/) - Khoj is an AGPL-3.0 personal AI assistant that searches the web and your own documents with local or online models, self-hosted or on Khoj's cloud app. ([Source (⭐38k)](https://github.com/khoj-ai/khoj))
*   [Kinetic Life OS](https://openappscout.com/apps/kinetic-life-os/) - Kinetic Life OS is a GPL-3.0 installable PWA that connects projects, everyday actions, health records, workouts, calendar review, and inspiration in one local-first personal workspace. ([Source (⭐1)](https://github.com/daoyi2026/kinetic-life-os))
*   [Leantime](https://openappscout.com/apps/leantime/) - Leantime is an AGPL-3.0, self-hostable project management system that combines strategy, planning and execution, with task views, goals, timesheets and docs in one tool. ([Source (⭐12k)](https://github.com/Leantime/leantime))
*   [Libre WebUI](https://openappscout.com/apps/libre-webui/) - Libre WebUI is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted AI workspace with local models through Ollama, document chat, artifacts and sandboxed work environments, and no application telemetry. ([Source (⭐88)](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui))
*   [LibreChat](https://openappscout.com/apps/librechat/) - LibreChat is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI chat platform with a ChatGPT-style interface, many model providers, agents, MCP and multi-user authentication, run with Docker Compose. ([Source (⭐46k)](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat))
*   [LimeSurvey](https://openappscout.com/apps/limesurvey/) - LimeSurvey is a GPL-licensed, self-hostable survey platform with branching logic, multilingual surveys, response statistics, plugins and an API. ([Source (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/LimeSurvey/LimeSurvey))
*   [Lotti](https://openappscout.com/apps/lotti/) - Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling, habits and health data, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents. ([Source (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/matthiasn/lotti))
*   [Minutes](https://openappscout.com/apps/minutes/) - Minutes is an MIT-licensed, local-first meeting and voice-memo recorder with on-device transcription, Markdown output, a CLI and an MCP server, for macOS and Windows with a CLI on Linux. ([Source (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/silverstein/minutes))
*   [Morphic](https://openappscout.com/apps/morphic/) - Morphic is an Apache-2.0 AI search engine with generative UI that self-hosts with Docker Compose, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama or other providers and SearxNG, Tavily, Brave or Exa for search. ([Source (⭐9.2k)](https://github.com/miurla/morphic))
*   [Open Cowork](https://openappscout.com/apps/open-cowork/) - Open Cowork is an MIT-licensed desktop agent for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs that works in a folder you choose and isolates its commands in a local VM, with your own API key. ([Source (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-cowork))
*   [OpenLess](https://openappscout.com/apps/openless/) - OpenLess is an AGPL-3.0 voice-typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android that transcribes speech and rewrites it in a chosen style, using the speech and language providers you configure. ([Source (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/Open-Less/openless))
*   [OpenMausBot](https://openappscout.com/apps/openmausbot/) - OpenMausBot is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Ubuntu that turns your local Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs into a roster of AI bots you chat with, each with its own computer. ([Source (⭐4k)](https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot))
*   [OpenProject](https://openappscout.com/apps/openproject/) - OpenProject is a GPL-3.0 project management platform for organisations that want a self-hosted alternative to Jira and MS Project, with agile boards, Gantt planning and time tracking. ([Source (⭐16k)](https://github.com/opf/openproject))
*   [OpenWhispr](https://openappscout.com/apps/openwhispr/) - OpenWhispr is an MIT-licensed voice dictation and meeting transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with on-device speech models or bring-your-own-key cloud models. ([Source (⭐8.9k)](https://github.com/OpenWhispr/openwhispr))
*   [OpenWork](https://openappscout.com/apps/openwork/) - OpenWork is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs AI agents on your own files with the model of your choice. The app is MIT; a separate team control plane is under a commercial licence. ([Source (⭐24k)](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork))
*   [OpenWorker](https://openappscout.com/apps/openworker/) - OpenWorker is an MIT-licensed desktop AI coworker for macOS and Windows that works with your own model key or Ollama and asks before anything consequential. ([Source (⭐18k)](https://github.com/andrewyng/openworker))

Projects / Open Source Projects

Introduction and Pre-Security / Level 1 - Intro

3. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • AFFiNE - AFFiNE is an open-source knowledge base that merges docs, whiteboard and databases on one canvas, with local-first storage, real-time collaboration and Docker self-hosting. (Source (⭐73k))
  • AgenticSeek - AgenticSeek is a GPL-3.0 autonomous AI agent that browses, codes and plans on your own machine with local models — a self-described local alternative to Manus. (Source (⭐27k))
  • Amical - Amical is an MIT-licensed, local-first AI dictation app for macOS and Windows, with context-aware formatting, custom vocabulary and an Android app. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • AnythingLLM - AnythingLLM is an MIT-licensed AI workspace for macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker that lets you chat with your own documents and run agents with a local or cloud model. (Source (⭐67k))
  • Baserow - Baserow is an open-core, self-hostable no-code database and app builder whose open-source edition is MIT-licensed, with a hosted cloud at baserow.io. (Source (⭐6.1k))
  • Eigent - Eigent is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that splits work across several AI agents running in parallel, with any model including local ones. (Source (⭐15k))
  • Excalidraw - Excalidraw is an MIT-licensed virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn-style diagrams, with end-to-end encrypted live collaboration, local-first autosave and a React component for embedding. (Source (⭐133k))
  • Flow Launcher - Flow Launcher is an MIT-licensed keyboard launcher for Windows 10 and 11 with fast file search, a preview panel and a large plugin ecosystem. (Source (⭐16k))
  • FluidVoice - FluidVoice is a free, GPL-3.0 macOS dictation app that transcribes on-device with very low latency and optionally cleans up text with a cloud or local model. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Formbricks - Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform — link, website, in-app and email surveys — that you can self-host with Docker or use as a cloud service. (Source (⭐13k))
  • FreeFlow - FreeFlow is an MIT-licensed Mac dictation app that transcribes and cleans up speech with Groq or any OpenAI-compatible provider you configure, with no FreeFlow server in between. (Source (⭐2.8k))
  • Grist - Grist is an Apache-licensed relational spreadsheet that combines spreadsheet formulas with database structure, self-hostable with Docker and available as a desktop app. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Handy - Handy is an MIT-licensed, fully offline dictation app for Windows, macOS and Linux that types what you say into any text field using Whisper or Parakeet on your own machine. (Source (⭐33k))
  • HeyForm - HeyForm is an AGPL-licensed, self-hostable builder for conversational forms, surveys, quizzes and polls, with logic, theming, analytics and integrations. (Source (⭐9k))
  • It's a Plan - It's a Plan is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted project management and issue tracking app where AI agents take issues on the same board as people, with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server. (Source (⭐883))
  • Jan - Jan is an Apache-2.0 desktop app that runs open LLMs offline on your own computer, with optional cloud models, custom assistants, MCP and a local OpenAI-compatible server. (Source (⭐45k))
  • Kanboard - Kanboard is an MIT-licensed Kanban project management app that focuses on simplicity, with WIP limits, automatic actions and a small PHP footprint. (Source (⭐9.9k))
  • Kaneo - Kaneo is an MIT-licensed, self-hostable project management app with boards, lists, calendars and Gantt charts, GitHub and Gitea integration, a REST API and MCP. (Source (⭐9.3k))
  • Khoj - Khoj is an AGPL-3.0 personal AI assistant that searches the web and your own documents with local or online models, self-hosted or on Khoj's cloud app. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Kinetic Life OS - Kinetic Life OS is a GPL-3.0 installable PWA that connects projects, everyday actions, health records, workouts, calendar review, and inspiration in one local-first personal workspace. (Source (⭐1))
  • Leantime - Leantime is an AGPL-3.0, self-hostable project management system that combines strategy, planning and execution, with task views, goals, timesheets and docs in one tool. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Libre WebUI - Libre WebUI is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted AI workspace with local models through Ollama, document chat, artifacts and sandboxed work environments, and no application telemetry. (Source (⭐88))
  • LibreChat - LibreChat is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI chat platform with a ChatGPT-style interface, many model providers, agents, MCP and multi-user authentication, run with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐46k))
  • LimeSurvey - LimeSurvey is a GPL-licensed, self-hostable survey platform with branching logic, multilingual surveys, response statistics, plugins and an API. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • Lotti - Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling, habits and health data, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents. (Source (⭐1.2k))
  • Minutes - Minutes is an MIT-licensed, local-first meeting and voice-memo recorder with on-device transcription, Markdown output, a CLI and an MCP server, for macOS and Windows with a CLI on Linux. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • Morphic - Morphic is an Apache-2.0 AI search engine with generative UI that self-hosts with Docker Compose, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama or other providers and SearxNG, Tavily, Brave or Exa for search. (Source (⭐9.2k))
  • Open Cowork - Open Cowork is an MIT-licensed desktop agent for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs that works in a folder you choose and isolates its commands in a local VM, with your own API key. (Source (⭐2.2k))
  • OpenLess - OpenLess is an AGPL-3.0 voice-typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android that transcribes speech and rewrites it in a chosen style, using the speech and language providers you configure. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • OpenMausBot - OpenMausBot is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Ubuntu that turns your local Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs into a roster of AI bots you chat with, each with its own computer. (Source (⭐4k))
  • OpenProject - OpenProject is a GPL-3.0 project management platform for organisations that want a self-hosted alternative to Jira and MS Project, with agile boards, Gantt planning and time tracking. (Source (⭐16k))
  • OpenWhispr - OpenWhispr is an MIT-licensed voice dictation and meeting transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with on-device speech models or bring-your-own-key cloud models. (Source (⭐8.9k))
